title: Senior Business Systems Analyst (Oracle)
jd_text: Job Description: The Senior Business Systems Analyst is a critical role within the Finance department, supporting the realization of Dimensional’s financial systems strategy through the translation of business requirements to technical solutions. This role will be critical to supporting the realization of the Company’s financial systems strategy through the execution of various projects, while supporting the maintenance of the Oracle Cloud ERP infrastructure on a day-to-day basis. This individual will be primarily responsible for the design, implementation, and testing of Oracle Cloud updates, as well as the resolution of technical issues that are encountered in the normal course of operations. In addition, this position will assume increasing responsibility for gathering requirements, design and implementation of Corporate Finance processes through collaboration with both business and functional stakeholders, with an emphasis on business analysis and utilizing the tools available across our financial systems. Responsibilities Provides day-to-day administrative direction and maintenance of the Oracle Cloud ERP and other financial system applications, including general production support activities (eg granting permissions, security controls and access, chart of accounts maintenance, etc.) Responsible for the maintenance, training and testing of upgrades to the Oracle Cloud ERP module. Evaluate, customize, and implement Oracle embedded AI and AI Agent Studio capabilities across Finance and Procurement modules. Assist in execution of changes to the Oracle Cloud ERP configuration and development of Oracle Transaction Business Intelligence Reports (OTBI). Collaboration with various departments to ensure the effective utilization of the Oracle Cloud ERP in support of business processes, collecting and documenting business and technical needs from stakeholders. Deliver a combination of process and financial systems technology expertise to meet functional requirements with an emphasis on automation and data integrity. Day-to-Day management and production support for multiple Oracle Cloud ERP modules and Oracle Cloud EPM. Supports the Financial Systems and Finance department through the design and adoption of standard operating procedures and best practices. Drives to continuous business/process improvement and efficiency. Strong communication skills and ability to build strong working relationships with end- users of Oracle Cloud and other financial systems. Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in a field such as Computer Science or Accounting and Finance. Experience with the Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP financials and procurement modules. Cross- functional knowledge in some or all of the following Oracle ERP Application Modules: Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash Management, Leases, General Ledger, with basic underlying understanding of Order-to-Cash and Procure- to- Pay processes. Proficiency in using applicable software applications and business systems. 5+ years of relevant work experience. Experience with end-to-end project deployment cycle that includes the design, development, testing and deployment of financial systems solutions into a production environment. Continuous learner and independent thinker who can work collaboratively with others. Strong communication and interpersonal skills to understand needs and priorities as well as to foster strong relationships and effective communication to ensure alignment with business partners. Ability to explain complex technical concepts to varying audiences. Strong analytical skills in order to evaluate user and business needs as well as accurately interpret data to develop sound conclusions and recommendations. This role is not eligible for immigration sponsorship. #LI-Onsite Dimensional offers a variety of programs to help take care of you, your family, and your career, including comprehensive benefits, educational initiatives, and special celebrations of our history, culture, and growth. It is the policy of the Company to provide equal opportunity for all employees and applicants. title: Staff IT Business Systems Analyst- Strategic Initiatives
jd_text: The Company Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health. We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. Meet the team: This highly visible role leads strategic technology initiatives that support Dexcom’s manufacturing and operations organizations. The position partners with business, IT, and operational technology teams to translate strategic priorities into scalable, compliant solutions across the manufacturing systems lifecycle. Working within a global IT organization, this leader will help advance operational excellence, digital transformation, and Dexcom’s continued growth. Where you come in: Drive strategic initiatives, partnering with business stakeholders to translate strategic priorities into executable initiatives, requirements, and solution roadmaps Analyze complex business problems and identify technology‑enabled solutions to drive scalability, efficiency, and value realization Identify opportunities to automate and optimize with standalone or embedded AI Agents Collaborate with IT and technical teams to design, develop, test, and implement solutions aligned to business needs Act as the voice of the business, eliciting requirements and translating into user stories, functional designs, and test scenarios Support testing, validation, and deployment activities, ensuring solutions meet quality, compliance, and business requirements Work cross-functionally with Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and IT teams to ensure alignment and drive execution in a matrixed environment Identify process improvement, automation, and digital enablement opportunities to support enterprise transformation initiatives Support development of business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and ROI tracking for strategic initiatives Facilitate workshops, drive stakeholder alignment, and ensure clear communication across business and IT teams What makes you successful: 5+ years of experience in all aspects of operations systems management, including strategy, development, and support. Experience with Machine Learning, Predictive Maintenance, AI for Manufacturing. GCP, Agentic AI, or Gemini Enterprise / Vertix preferred. Understanding of FDA requirements for validated systems, including GMP/GxP, ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Parts 11 and 820, and electronic records/e-signatures compliance preferred. Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Six Sigma experience or certification preferred. What you’ll get: A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community . A full and comprehensive benefits program. Growth opportunities within the arena of Medical Affairs. Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement. An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve. title: Senior Advisor, Business Systems Integration Project Manager
jd_text: DISA Global Solutions is a leading safety and compliance provider supporting more than 55,000 customers worldwide, including over 30% of the Fortune 500. With 1,600+ team members across 30+ locations, we’ve delivered innovative solutions since 1986 and process more than 20 million orders each year. As a multi-year Top Workplaces award winner, DISA offers competitive pay, robust benefits, and a collaborative, growth-focused culture. Employees enjoy ongoing training through our internal learning and development team, monthly appreciation events, and numerous opportunities for career advancement. Position Summary: The Senior Advisor, Business Systems Integration Project Manager will lead the delivery of integrations between DISA’s background screening platforms and the Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), HR technology, recruiting technology, and HRIS platforms used by our clients. This role is responsible for managing integration projects from initiation through production launch, ensuring projects are delivered on time, meet technical and business requirements, and provide a high-quality experience for both internal stakeholders and clients. The position leads complex, high-impact integrations involving enterprise clients, multiple platforms, and significant cross-functional dependencies. Essential Functions and responsibilities: Lead integration projects from initiation through deployment, stabilization, and closure while managing complex enterprise‑level implementations across multiple platforms and teams. Define project structure by establishing scope, requirements, milestones, timelines, dependencies, governance, escalation paths, decision processes, and change controls. Develop project plans and maintain status updates, risk and issue logs, action items, and performance tracking across scope, schedule, quality, client experience, and launch readiness. Identify and resolve risks by proactively addressing dependencies, delivery challenges, and cross‑functional blockers. Manage resources by balancing multiple concurrent projects, coordinating resource needs, and partnering with leaders to resolve competing priorities. Ensure process adherence by driving alignment to established integration standards, patterns, and delivery timelines. Communicate with stakeholders through clear updates on status, risks, decisions, and changes while facilitating kickoff, status, escalation, and steering meetings. Translate requirements by converting business needs into actionable technical requirements and coordinating data mapping between ATS platforms and DISA systems. Partner across teams including Engineering, Security, Legal, Compliance, Sales, Implementation, and Account Management to ensure technical accuracy, regulatory alignment, and clear ownership. Coordinate technical delivery by facilitating discussions, documenting decisions, and overseeing development, configuration, testing, defect resolution, and deployment activities. Lead testing and validation through end‑to‑end test coordination, defect tracking, client validation, and readiness confirmation. Serve as primary contact by leading structured client meetings, setting expectations, and building trusted relationships through proactive communication. Drive continuous improvement by conducting post‑launch reviews, incorporating lessons learned, and identifying enhancements to lifecycle processes, tools, documentation, and standardization. Mentor team members by providing guidance, supporting best practices, and contributing reusable templates, checklists, requirements documentation, and integration playbooks. Support repeatable delivery by contributing to standardized ATS integration implementations and ensuring documentation is complete prior to project closure. Others duties as assigned Key Skills and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems, Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. An equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree. 7+ years of experience managing technical projects, software implementations, integrations, or similar technology initiatives. Experience leading complex, client-facing technology or integration projects. Experience with project governance, change control, risk management, and executive reporting. Experience managing projects involving APIs, system integrations, SaaS platforms, or data exchange. Strong understanding of software development and implementation lifecycles. Strong project planning, organization, prioritization, and problem-solving skills. Experience managing external clients and multiple internal stakeholders. Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment. Strong attention to detail and ability to identify gaps, dependencies, and risks. Benefits: Personal and Sick Paid Time Off. 401k with a highly competitive match. 11 Paid Holidays. Medical/Dental and Vision. Group Life Insurance, HSA/FSA. Employee Assistance Program. Educational Assistance Program . Work/Training Schedule: Mon – Fri 8:00 am – 5:00 pm EST Travel: This position requires regular travel to support partner and client meetings, integration discovery, implementation activities, industry conferences, and related business needs. Travel is expected to average approximately 25% based on business needs. Internal Mapping: This role aligns to the internal job profile of Senior Advisor, Project Management within the Project Management job family. Physical Requirements: • While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to speak, hear, have close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Walk (occasionally), sit- up to 8hrs. a day, stand (occasionally), use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms, able to lift up to 15lbs.(occasionally). Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Compensation for this role is determined by factors such as skills, experience, education, training, and internal equity. Pay may also vary based on geographic location in accordance with our compensation practices. Job Pay Range $95,000 - $125,000 Annually (DOE) EEO/M/F/Vet/Disability

title: Senior Operations Manager
jd_text: About Us We are a global climate technologies company engineered for sustainability. We create sustainable and efficient residential, commercial and industrial spaces through HVACR technologies. We protect temperature-sensitive goods throughout the cold chain. And we bring comfort to people globally. Best-in-class engineering, design and manufacturing combined with category-leading brands in compression, controls, software and monitoring solutions result in next-generation climate technology that is built for the needs of the world ahead. Whether you are a professional looking for a career change, an undergraduate student exploring your first opportunity, or recent graduate with an advanced degree, we have opportunities that will allow you to innovate, be challenged and make an impact. Join our team and start your journey today! Description If you are a senior operations leader passionate about building high-performing teams and driving operational excellence, we have an exciting opportunity for you! Based at our Forney Distribution Center, you will be responsible for overseeing day-to-day warehouse operations, including inbound receiving, outbound shipping, inventory execution, and order fulfillment. This role is accountable for delivering safe, efficient, and reliable operations while driving continuous improvement across safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity. You will partner closely with Customer Service, Inventory, Materials, Transportation, and other cross-functional teams to improve operational performance, eliminate waste, and build sustainable operating processes. The Senior Operations manager is also responsible for building and maintaining positive employee relations and developing leadership strength within the Distribution Center. This position operates under the general guidance of the Plant Manager. As the Senior Operations Manager, you will: Oversee warehouse operations including receiving, putaway, replenishment, picking, shipping, and inventory execution Drive safety, quality, delivery, cost, and productivity performance through disciplined daily management and KPI reviews Lead, coach, and develop managers of managers while fostering a culture of accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement Monitor operational performance using KPIs such as throughput, labor productivity, inventory accuracy, dock-to-stock, order accuracy, and on-time shipment Partner with Customer Service, Inventory, Transportation, and Materials to resolve operational constraints and improve customer service performance Drive root cause analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions for operational issues Ensure compliance with safety regulations, OSHA requirements, and company policies Oversee continuous improvement initiatives to optimize warehouse layout, material flow, labor utilization, and operating processes Develop and maintain standard work, operating procedures (SOPs), and operational controls Support peak planning, workforce planning, and resource allocation to meet business demands Lead additional projects and initiatives as assigned by the Plant Manager Required education, experiences & skills: Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Logistics, Business, Operations, or a related field (or equivalent experience) 5+ years of direct management experience in leadership in warehouse, distribution center, or manufacturing operations Demonstrated experience leading managers and supervisors in a high-volume, metrics-driven environment Strong knowledge of warehouse operations, inventory management, and shipping/receiving processes Experience utilizing ERP and Warehouse Management Systems (Oracle, SAP, Manhattan, etc.) Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills Excellent communication and cross-functional leadership skills Proven ability to drive operational improvements through data, standard work, and continuous improvement methodologies Preferred education, experiences & skills: Experience leading multi-shift distribution center operations Lean, Six Sigma, or Continuous Improvement experience Experience with Daily Management Systems (Tier meetings, KPI reviews, Leader Standard Work) Ability to handle changing priorities and use good judgement in multiple situations Knowledge of warehouse automation and material handling systems Experience leading change management and operational transformation initiatives OSHA knowledge and forklift safety certification preferred Why Work in the Dallas-Fort Worth Area Our distribution center is located in Forney, TX, one of the fastest-growing communities in the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. Conveniently located just east of Dallas, Forney offers easy access to world-class dining, entertainment, professional sports, shopping, and cultural attractions throughout the DFW area. Residents enjoy a strong sense of community, highly rated schools, affordable housing options compared to many major metro areas, and a variety of parks, recreation, and family-friendly activities. About Our Location Our Forney Distribution Center plays a key role in supporting Copeland customers across North America through efficient warehousing, inventory management, and order fulfillment operations. The facility serves as a critical hub within our supply chain network, helping ensure the timely delivery of HVACR products and solutions to customers. Team members work closely across operations, customer service, materials, inventory, and transportation functions in a fast-paced, collaborative environment focused on safety, quality, and continuous improvement. As the site continues to grow, employees have opportunities to develop their skills and advance their careers within Copeland's global organization. Onsite Work Arrangement: This role is based fully onsite, and not eligible for hybrid or remote work opportunities #LI-FS1 Our Commitment to Our People Across the globe, we are united by a singular Purpose: Sustainability is no small ambition. That’s why everything we do is geared toward a sustainable future—for our generation and all those to come. Through groundbreaking innovations, HVACR technology and cold chain solutions, we are reducing carbon emissions and improving energy efficiency in spaces of all sizes, from residential to commercial to industrial. Our employees are our greatest strength. We believe that our culture of passion, openness, and collaboration empowers us to work toward the same goal - to make the world a better place. We invest in the end-to-end development of our people, beginning at onboarding and through senior leadership, so they can thrive personally and professionally. Flexible and competitive benefits plans offer the right options to meet your individual/family needs: medical insurance plans, dental and vision coverage, 401(k) and more. We provide employees with flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave, vacation and holiday leave. Together, we have the opportunity – and the power – to continue to revolutionize the technology behind air conditioning, heating and refrigeration, and cultivate a better future. Learn more about us and how you can join our team! title: Business Systems Analyst / JIRA Administrator
jd_text: Serves as the Business Systems Analyst and JIRA Administrator for pre-production efforts. Responsible for formulating systems scope and objectives relative to the organization's business plan and industry requirements, and acts as a member of a project team responsible for providing technical guidance concerning the business implications of the application of various systems. This position requires many years of experience with requirements and with setting up and managing projects and sprints in JIRA, along with many years of experience in Agile methodologies. Scrum Master experience is useful, and experience transitioning an organization from waterfall to Agile is a bonus. *Position is contingent upon contract award. Award anticipated December 2026/January 2027.* Responsibilities: Set up, configure, administer, and manage the JIRA environment supporting delivery — including projects, workflows, permissions, boards, sprints, dashboards, and integrations. Manage sprint planning, backlog grooming, and sprint execution within JIRA across the delivery workstreams. Gather, document, and manage system requirements, maintaining traceability from requirement through sprint execution. Apply Agile methodologies across the program and support Scrum ceremonies and cadence. Support the transition of delivery practices from waterfall to Agile where applicable. Identify, capture, and report key performance measures and indicators necessary to articulate progress, tied to industry best practices, standards, and benchmarking; establish an initial baseline within 30 days of contract award and provide monthly reporting against it. Define and maintain project burn-up/burn-down performance reporting established at the Project Baseline Review. Support the JPMO in planning, execution, and reporting requirements, and assist in the creation, update, management, and analysis of data supporting the Integrated Master Schedule. Integrate JIRA with the CI/CD pipeline and test management tooling to provide end-to-end delivery visibility. Provide technical guidance concerning the business implications of the application of various systems. Other duties as assigned. Qualifications: Years of Experience: Four (4) years Education Level: BS/BA in Information Systems, Business, Engineering, or a closely related discipline, or equivalent additional relevant experience. Clearance Requirements: Secret. Must possess IT-II Non-Critical Sensitive security clearance or Tier 3 (T3) at time of proposal submission. Certification Requirements: Must hold a Project Management certification (i.e., Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or other equivalent/recognized Project Management certification) Any other work-related qualifications needed for the role: Many years of experience setting up and managing projects and sprints in JIRA. Many years of experience in Agile methodologies. Scrum Master experience would be useful. Experience moving an organization from waterfall to Agile is a bonus. Demonstrated experience gathering and managing system requirements. Per the JETS 2 LCAT: must have experience working with DOD Lifecycle management, DOD 5000.1, 5000.2 and Guidebook, PPBE, DPATS system engineering tool, Defense Acquisition Management Information Retrieval (DAMIR) System reporting format for DAES, OSD report, and SAP products for Enterprise Resource Planning. Must have experience with the following programs: MS Suite, Word, Excel, Access, Project Management, and PowerPoint. Extensive experience working highly complex IT systems. Resume must demonstrate experience working legacy system upgrades, modernization, legacy system transition, data migration and/or system analysis and design. Priority given to personnel with demonstrated experience performing functional and technical solutions decomposition that enables solutions analysis and design, and demonstrated experience implementing solutions with respect to modern database design and modern software languages within the federal Government, specifically within the DoD. AI/ML experience is preferred. Travel to on-site meetings in Columbus, OH (Onsite once per month (average) up to 3 days.) title: PMO Technical Program Manager
jd_text: Red Canyon Technologies is seeking a PMO Technical Program Manager to support integrated program planning, governance, reporting, and execution control. This position is responsible for maintaining a reliable, evidence-based view of program schedules, deliverables, dependencies, costs, staffing needs, risks, issues, and decisions across assigned workstreams and task orders. The PMO Technical Program Manager will help program leadership and delivery teams convert complex or ambiguous status into clear ownership, documented decisions, actionable due dates, and objective evidence of progress. This is a program-level management and integration role. The successful candidate must be technically fluent enough to understand modernization activities, recognize delivery and technical dependencies, ask informed questions, and communicate their implications. The position is not, however, the program’s independent architecture or technical approval authority. Technical findings, architecture decisions, and modernization recommendations remain the responsibility of the designated technical leads and appropriate Government decision authorities. The PMO Technical Program Manager will work closely with program leadership, task-order project managers, technical leads, subcontractors, and Government stakeholders to improve delivery predictability, reporting consistency, phase-gate readiness, and timely escalation of material risks and decisions. Key Responsibilities Maintain an integrated view of program schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, risks, issues, decisions, staffing needs, and cost or effort status across assigned activities. Maintain the program deliverable register and coordinate the timely preparation, review, revision, submission, and status reporting of required deliverables. Prepare and coordinate weekly status reports, monthly program reporting, leadership briefings, customer communications, and other recurring program-management materials. Reconcile status information across schedules, work plans, deliverable records, cost or effort information, and team updates. Identify inconsistencies, unsupported completion claims, and missing evidence before information is reported. Translate ambiguous status into a clearly documented owner, required action or decision, target date, dependency, and supporting evidence. Maintain program-level risk, issue, action, and decision records. Ensure that material concerns are documented, assigned, tracked, and escalated through the appropriate governance path. Coordinate phase-gate readiness across task orders and workstreams, including review schedules, required artifacts, outstanding decisions, dependencies, and supporting evidence. Establish and maintain disciplined program-management records using approved program management systems. Support task-order project managers and technical leads in maintaining consistent planning, status reporting, risk management, decision tracking, and deliverable-control practices. Identify dependencies and resource conflicts that cross task-order or organizational boundaries and facilitate their resolution or escalation. Coordinate cost and effort status with authorized program, financial, contracts, and delivery personnel. Surface material variances, unresolved assumptions, or inconsistencies for review. Facilitate recurring program-management meetings, reviews, and working sessions. Document decisions, actions, owners, and due dates, and follow through to closure. Prepare concise, accurate, and audience-appropriate communications for Government stakeholders, company leadership, delivery teams, and subcontractor partners. Maintain an explicit distinction between contractor recommendations, internal management decisions, and decisions reserved for the Government. Support dependable and consistent customer messaging across task orders, phases, reviews, and reporting cycles. Support program staffing coordination, onboarding, and resource planning as assigned and within the authority delegated to the position. Support lessons learned, after-action reviews, and process improvement activities to strengthen program controls and delivery consistency. Support proposal, capture, task-order response, or labor-category activities as needed. Required Qualifications Clearance Requirements: Secret 8+ years of experience in IT program or project management, with at least 3 years managing Federal Government contracts. Demonstrated technical fluency sufficient to engage with architects, engineers, and modernization SMEs; identify dependencies and risks; challenge unsupported conclusions; and translate technical issues into program, schedule, cost, and customer impacts. Demonstrated experience managing integrated plans across multiple technical workstreams, projects, or task orders. Demonstrated capability in schedule integration, deliverable control, dependency management, and phase or gate readiness. Experience maintaining and using risk, issue, action, and decision records to support delivery and management decisions. Strong written communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear Government/customer status reports, executive summaries, decision materials, and escalation notices. Experience reconciling schedule, deliverable, cost, effort, staffing, and status information from multiple sources. Ability to distinguish verified progress from assumptions, estimates, planned activity, and unsupported completion claims. Demonstrated judgment in facilitation, escalation, stakeholder coordination, and the handling of sensitive or protected information. Ability to translate technical constraints, dependencies, and uncertainty into clear program-management impacts without overstating technical conclusions. Experience working with technical leads, project managers, operational teams, contracts personnel, financial personnel, subcontractors, and customer stakeholders. Experience establishing or maintaining disciplined program records in collaborative environments such as Microsoft Planner, SharePoint, and Teams. Ability to operate effectively in a technically complex delivery environment where schedules, deliverables, dependencies, costs, and customer expectations must remain aligned. Preferred Qualifications PMP, PgMP, or an equivalent program or project management credential. Relevant agile delivery training or experience where agile practices are used by the assigned workstreams. Experience supporting Federal Government or Department of Defense technology programs. Experience operating a program management office for a multi-project, multiple-task-order, or multi-vendor delivery environment. Familiarity with IDIQ and task-order delivery structures, contract deliverables, customer reviews, and Government decision processes. Familiarity with mainframe modernization, legacy-system assessment, cloud migration, enterprise application modernization, or other technically complex transformation initiatives. Experience establishing consistent program controls across teams that use different delivery methods, schedules, tools, or reporting practices. Experience supporting program cost, effort, resource, or staffing reconciliation in coordination with authorized financial and contracts personnel. Experience facilitating phase-gate, milestone, deliverable, risk, and executive program reviews. title: Senior Operations Manager
jd_text: Join Vetcove and help modernize the future of veterinary software and the pet parent healthcare experience. Our suite of platforms features a market-leading procurement marketplace, an ultra-modern home delivery ecommerce experience, and a next-generation practice management system. More than 25,000 hospitals across all 50 states rely on Vetcove daily, supporting tens of thousands of veterinarians who care for tens of millions of pets each year. We are modernizing the 50 billion dollar plus animal health industry by giving veterinary organizations the tools to focus more on patient care. Backed by Y Combinator and top venture investors in Silicon Valley, New York and Miami, Vetcove is a fast-growing, mission-driven company. We are searching for talented and passionate people who want to help shape the future of veterinary care. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own Vendor Performance Management: Run the weekly performance cadence across all fulfillment vendors: scorecard reviews, follow-ups, and corrective action plans; and hold partners accountable to SLAs with persistence and professionalism. - Manage Partner Relationships: Serve as the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of fulfillment vendors: own the recurring meeting cadence, lead business reviews, advocate for Vetcove externally, and keep relationships strong through the ups and downs of operational performance. - Analyze at Scale: Interrogate large datasets (SQL, Excel, BI tools) to identify root causes, quantify operational impact, and build the case for process and integration changes. Defend your conclusions with data. - Partner with Product & Engineering: Translate recurring operational failure modes into integration and fulfillment improvements; write clear requirements, drive prioritization, and follow through until fixes ship and the metrics move. - Operationalize New Initiatives: Take run-state ownership of newly launched programs: build the SOPs, own the KPIs, and make the operational decisions that keep them healthy at scale. - Build Operational Rigor: Author and maintain SOPs, escalation paths, and process documentation that make our vendor operations consistent, auditable, and scalable as the platform grows. WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR - 5-8 years of experience in operations, program management, marketplace/ecommerce operations, or supply chain – ideally in roles where you were accountable for external partner performance. - A documented record of relentless follow-through: you chase answers across organizations, escalate when needed, never let a thread die, and deliver on time without being reminded. - Strong analytical skills: proficiency in SQL (or demonstrated equivalent), advanced Excel/Sheets, and comfort drawing defensible conclusions from large, messy datasets. - Exceptional attention to detail: you notice the mismatched count, the silent data gap, the SLA miss buried in an average. - Experience managing vendor or partner relationships end to end; serving as a partner’s main point of contact, and balancing relationship-building with direct, constructive accountability conversations. - Excellent written communication and the ability to work cross-functionally with product and engineering teams. - Self-directed and highly organized in a fully remote environment. NICE TO HAVE - Experience in ecommerce fulfillment, 3PL, pharmacy, or distribution operations. - Familiarity with BI/analytics tools (e.g., Hex, Looker, Tableau) and building or maintaining operational dashboards. - Background in animal health, healthcare, or another regulated fulfillment category. BENEFITS (FULL TIME ROLES) - 100% remote within the USA - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance - Automatic 401k contribution - Employee referral program - At home office set up - Bi-annual company retreats - Open vacation policy - Equity - Monthly team events The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is: $100,000/year -$150,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations. For Colorado, the salary range is: $115,000 - $140,000 + bonus + equity + benefits. This salary range is a good faith estimate of what Vetcove may pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on skills, qualifications, and experience. The range reflects the base hourly rate or annual compensation (as applicable), and does not include bonus, equity or other incentives. In addition to base compensation, Vetcove offers a comprehensive benefits package. Please refer to the “Benefits (Full Time Roles)” section above for more details. To apply, please submit your application through Vetcove’s Careers Page. The application deadline is on an ongoing basis. Please note we are unable to sponsor work visas at this time. Attention all job seekers! We want to ensure that you’re well-informed about a serious matter affecting the job market. It has come to our attention that scammers are operating in the industry, impersonating employees and attempting to deceive savvy applicants like you. Here’s what you need to know: 1. Our job listings are exclusively available on official sites (our careers page, LinkedIn, BuiltIn, and Indeed). Be cautious of other sources claiming to represent us or any organization that you’re interested in. Stay on the lookout! 2. Authentic communications from our company will only come through verified email addresses and phone numbers. If you receive unexpected messages or calls, exercise caution and verify their authenticity. Don’t let scammers catch you off guard! 3. It's essential to independently verify the legitimacy of any job postings you come across. Visit our official careers page to confirm the validity of any openings. Stay proactive and protect yourself! 4. Remember that during the application process, we will never request sensitive personal or financial information from you. Be wary of anyone asking for such information. Keep your personal data secure! 5. If you suspect any fraudulent activity or encounter suspicious individuals, please report it immediately to our recruiting department. By working together, we can combat these scams and keep the job market safer for everyone. We understand the importance of your job search and want to ensure your experience is positive and secure. Always exercise caution and stay scam-smart! Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. title: Technical Project Manager - Temporary Worker
jd_text: Job Description: **TEMP Role – W2 on Dentsu Payroll Only **ASAP – 12/31/2026 **Approximately 40 Hours/Week **Progressive Project Management Experience at a Digital Agency **IN-OFFICE REQUIREMENT 3 DAYS/WEEK - MUST BE WITHIN A 90 MINUTE COMMUTE TO PLAINSBORO, NJ CLIENT OFFICE** Company Description: Merkle, a dentsu company, powers the experience economy. For more than 35 years, the company has put people at the heart of its approach to digital business transformation. As the only integrated experience consultancy in the world with a heritage in data science and business performance, Merkle delivers holistic, end-to-end experiences that drive growth, engagement, and loyalty. Merkle's expertise has earned recognition as a "Leader" by top industry analyst firms, in categories such as digital transformation and commerce, experience design, engineering and technology integration, digital marketing, data science, CRM and loyalty, and customer data management. With more than 16,000 employees, Merkle operates in 30+ countries throughout the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. ROLE PURPOSE The TEMPORARY Technical Project Manager is the operational execution leader for Adobe Experience Cloud implementation workstreams for our Healthcare client - serving as the bridge between solution architecture, delivery teams, and engagement leadership. This role owns day-to-day delivery coordination, sprint planning and execution, dependency management, and risk mitigation for assigned technical workstreams—ensuring that architectural designs are built as intended, on time, on budget, and to quality standards. This role requires in-office presence 3x per week at client offices in Plainsboro, NJ. This role combines deep technical fluency with hands-on project management discipline. You manage teams of 5-15 technical professionals (engineers, data engineers, architects, QA), coordinate across distributed teams and time zones, remove blockers, and drive measurable progress against sprint commitments. You translate technical complexity into clear status communication for stakeholders while maintaining the trust and engagement of your delivery team. Essentially, this role operates at the intersection of technical execution and stakeholder clarity—converting solution designs into built, tested, deployed capabilities while keeping teams coordinated, risks visible, and stakeholders informed. RESPONSIBILITY AREAS Sprint Planning & Execution · Own sprint planning for assigned workstream(s); break down solution architecture and epics into well-defined stories and tasks with clear acceptance criteria · Conduct rigorous story estimation with the delivery team; flag scope concerns and dependencies early · Maintain backlog discipline: prioritize work, manage scope changes, track velocity, and adapt plans based on delivery reality · Drive daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives; ensure ceremonies are efficient and action-oriented · Track sprint metrics: velocity, on-time delivery, defect escape rate, rework; identify trends and coaching opportunities · Manage sprint-to-sprint continuity: document decisions, carry forward blockers, and maintain momentum across sprints Technical Team Leadership & Coordination · Lead matrixed technical teams spanning engineers, data engineers, architects, QA, and other specialists; foster collaboration and accountability · Clarify technical requirements and design intent for the team; reduce ambiguity and unnecessary back-and-forth with architects or clients · Conduct regular 1:1s with team members; understand capacity, concerns, and growth opportunities; provide coaching and feedback · Coordinate across geographies and time zones; ensure synchronization and clear handoff protocols for distributed work Dependency & Blocker Management · Maintain a comprehensive view of workstream dependencies: cross-team, cross-engagement, vendor, and client-side · Identify and escalate blockers early; propose workarounds or mitigation strategies; drive resolution with urgency · Coordinate dependencies across parallel workstreams; align timing and handoffs to prevent downstream delays · Facilitate cross-team sync meetings when dependencies require real-time coordination or decision-making · Track high-risk dependencies; flag to engagement leadership for escalation if resolution is stalled Quality & Technical Standards · Define and enforce acceptance criteria for all deliverables; ensure quality is non-negotiable · Conduct or facilitate code/design reviews; ensure work aligns with architectural intent and technical standards · Partner with QA to ensure comprehensive test coverage; identify and track defects; manage rework efficiently · Maintain visibility into technical debt and architectural risks; escalate issues that threaten delivery or future maintainability · Track and report on quality metrics: defect rates, escape rate, rework percentage; identify systemic issues Delivery Progress & Risk Management · Maintain clear visibility into workstream health: track deliverables, timeline, budget, and team capacity · Report progress to engagement leadership weekly; flag risks, issues, and decisions requiring escalation · Implement early warning systems: identify slippage indicators and intervene before issues compound · Maintain a live risk and issue register; assess impact and probability; facilitate mitigation planning · Communicate transparently about timeline and scope trade-offs; help leadership make informed decisions · Conduct postmortems on slippages or quality issues; capture lessons and prevent recurrence Stakeholder Communication & Expectation Management · Serve as primary communication conduit between delivery team and engagement leadership/client stakeholders · Provide clear, jargon-free status updates for non-technical stakeholders; translate technical complexity into business terms · Set and manage expectations on timeline, scope, and quality; be honest about constraints and trade-offs · Facilitate design reviews and demo sessions with clients; ensure feedback is captured and prioritized appropriately · Address stakeholder questions and concerns with urgency; escalate unresolved issues to engagement leadership · Build credibility through consistent, transparent communication Vendor & Tool Management · Manage interactions with Adobe Professional Services, Adobe Support, and other vendors; track SLAs and escalate unresponsive support · Stay current on Adobe product capabilities, roadmap, and best practices; ensure team leverages new features appropriately · Advocate for tooling and infrastructure improvements; gather team feedback on pain points and efficiency barriers · Support technical team in Adobe platform training, certification, and skill development QUALIFICATIONS Experience & Background · Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field · 4+ years of technical project management experience in software development, systems integration, or consulting delivery. Progressive technical project management experience at a digital agency preferred. · 2+ years of hands-on experience managing Adobe Experience Cloud or comparable enterprise technology implementations · Proven track record managing technical teams of 5-15+ professionals across multiple disciplines · Experience working in agile and hybrid delivery environments · Demonstrated success managing complex, multi-workstream technical projects with dependencies across teams Technical Fluency & Platform Knowledge · Working knowledge of Adobe Experience Cloud: hands-on familiarity with at least 2-3 of AEM, Experience Platform, Journey Optimizer, Analytics, or comparable platforms · Understanding of data architecture, APIs, integrations, and cloud infrastructure; able to discuss technical trade-offs with engineers and architects · Comfort with technical concepts (data models, identity resolution, performance optimization, governance) without requiring hand-holding · Familiarity with modern development practices: version control, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, observability · Experience with Agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe); ability to apply appropriately to delivery context Project Management & Delivery Skills · Expertise in sprint planning, backlog management, capacity planning, and velocity tracking · Proficiency in project management tools: Jira, Smartsheet, Azure DevOps, Asana, or similar · Strong estimation discipline: ability to assess complexity, identify estimation risks, and adjust plans accordingly · Dependency tracking and risk management: maintain clarity on blockers and escalate with urgency · Metrics-driven mindset: establish KPIs, track performance, and use data to drive team improvement · Timeline and budget accountability: manage workstream spend and forecast, avoid cost overruns Leadership & Communication · Proven ability to lead diverse technical teams; The hourly pay rate for the successful candidate is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. title: Operations Manager-USA
jd_text: Cryoport Systems is a comprehensive supply chain partner for the life sciences industry, delivering specialized solutions to meet the challenges of the biopharmaceutical, cell and gene therapy, reproductive medicine, and animal health markets. Our offerings span logistics, BioServices and biostorage, cryopreservation, and consulting, ensuring the highest standards of quality and reliability for sensitive materials. With our expansive platform of management solutions and decades of temperature-controlled supply chain expertise, Cryoport Systems helps Enable the Outcome™ by supporting certainty and precision in the supply chain, whether advancing groundbreaking therapies, supporting families on their reproductive journeys, or enhancing animal health programs. POSITION SUMMARY The Operations Manager - BioServices role ensures all operational activities are executed accurately and timely, following specific procedures and processes defined in work instructions created by Program Managers. The responsibilities of the Operations Manager - BioServices involves overseeing all projects performed in the BioServices area for multiple commercial and government clients and assembling various types of kits and label printing. These materials are stored at ambient (room temperature) to below freezing (including cryogenic) with potentially hazardous properties. This role will also require communicating with Program Managers, scheduling work and supervising staff, writing and updating SOPs, and other project-related activities. PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES ( include but are not limited to ): •Lead and direct the safety and quality of daily operations. Oversee all tasks on the floor including Inventory System operations; aid and troubleshoot discrepancies when required. •Coordinate with program managers, customer service, and logistic center to ensure on-time delivery of project work and deadlines. •Will effectively communicate to ensure all project related information is conveyed in a timely and comprehensive manner. •Ensure all activities follow health, safety, and environmental statutory, regulatory, and company regulations. •Assure the on-time completion of document review (batch records, receipts, shipment orders, daily routine tasks, inspections, and logbooks) for completeness and accuracy. Ensures all job-related paperwork is correct, error-free, and completed as per SOPs. •Demonstrate solid technical writing abilities. Develop, revise, and assist in writing SOPs, work instructions, deviation investigations, and change controls. •Maintain and ensure the team remains current on safety, quality, and GMP training. •Perform administrative tasks including but not limited to scheduling and assigning duties, on call monitoring, attendance, disciplinary action management, planning and time off scheduling, hiring, and payroll. •Assists with Quality Control tasks such as verification, validation and calibration procedures as required. •Coordinate stock management and receipt of kit production, packaging, and labeling materials. •Manage stock levels of kit materials, packaging, and labeling components. •Ensures project work areas are kept clean and free of any possible safety hazards. •Monitors the inventory management system, temperature monitoring, and site infrastructure systems. •Works around hazardous substances and follows all safety guidelines to minimize exposure. •Assures compliance with cGMP requirements, safety, and company quality systems. •Responsible for complying with all company and HR policies and procedures. •Will lead, participate, and contribute to operational excellence and process improvement projects that cost-effectively deliver the business objectives. •Will always ensure strict client confidentiality. •To participate and contribute to operational excellence and process improvement projects that cost-effectively deliver the business objectives. •Supervision of temporary contract staff as required. •To participate in client audits, facility presentations and tours as needed. •Perform project/task-specific training as required. •May be assigned as the Designated Representative for their location for state licensing for commercial drug distribution. •Other duties as assigned COMPETENCIES & PERSONAL ATTRIBUTES •Exhibit appropriate behavior, language, and appearance always. •Follows policy when escorting client sponsors through the facility, is courteous, and displays a positive attitude. •Maintains a professional manner when problems/conflicts arise. •Hands-on experience working with biological and pharmaceutical materials is desirable. •Hands-on experience working in clinical packaging and labeling is desirable. •Good understanding of quality management •Previous experience working with materials at ultra-low & cryogenic temperatures is desirable. •Health, Safety and Environmental experience/qualification is desirable. •Flexible and adaptable with excellent interpersonal skills (at all levels). •Able to analyze problems and define solutions. •Attention to detail - "right first time" mentality. •Able to work under pressure and to support others within the team. •Builds customer commitment. •Supports operational excellence (30/30) •Focus on priorities (80/20) •Teamwork, collaboration, and accountability (90/10) •Emphasis on business growth •Passion for and alignment with, Cryoport's mission •A change agent and strong collaborator who is not afraid of challenging the status quo. •An individual who brings strong core values, quality, ethics, and integrity. •A collaborative team player who embraces and champions the culture. •Strong work ethic and ability to deliver results and meet commitments in a dynamic environment. •Exceptional and dynamic communications skills with the ability to inspire and influence people at all levels, build consensus and commitment, and effectively drive change throughout the organization at a rate that fits the corporate culture. •Exceptional organizational and planning skills, strong analytical abilities, and process orientation •Demonstrates a business process orientation to developing solutions. QUALIFICATIONS AND EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS •Degree level, or equivalent experience, in a relevant discipline. •Minimum 4 years' experience working in a GMP / GxP environment. •Minimum of 1 years' Managery experience preferred. •Hands-on experience working with biological and pharmaceutical materials and drug products. •Hands-on experience working in clinical packaging and labeling is desirable. •Line management experience is desirable. •Proficient in computer skills, specifically with Microsoft Office Suite. •Health, Safety, and Environmental knowledge is desirable. •Experience working in a contract development or manufacturing environment is a plus. •Willingness to function in an "on-call" rotation to support needs of business DRUG TEST This position is subject to pre-employment drug testing in accordance with our commitment to maintaining a safe and drug-free workplace.

title: Senior Operations Engineering Program Manager
jd_text: CyrusOne is a leading global data center developer and operator, delivering secure, scalable, and reliable infrastructure solutions for the world’s largest enterprises and hyperscale customers. We are committed to operational excellence, innovation, and delivering high-performance environments that support critical business needs. The Senior Operations Engineering Program Manager supports execution across key engineering initiatives. This role is responsible for coordinating program activities and contributing to frameworks that enable the successful delivery of operational priorities. The position supports the tracking and reporting of key performance metrics, monitors program and process effectiveness, and highlights insights to support continuous improvement. This individual partners cross-functionally to help translate strategic plans into actionable deliverables, ensuring alignment and progress across the engineering organization. The role focuses on driving day-to-day program execution, maintaining visibility into milestones, and supporting accountability to deliver operational results. New Capacity Readiness Program Leadership Own the programmatic framework for new capacity readiness across power and mechanical systems, ensuring consistent execution across sites and projects. Coordinate across commissioning, engineering, and site operations teams to align scope, sequencing, and milestones. Track commissioning issues, defects, and punch-list items at the program level, ensuring accountability, prioritization, and timely closure. Lead the development and execution of Day 1 (new capacity) readiness programs, establishing clear readiness criteria, stage gates, and exit conditions. Lead the development and execution of a standardized turnover process for accepting new capacity into operation. Risk Management & Mitigation Program Ownership Lead the development and execution of Day 2 (operational reliability) readiness programs. Establish and maintain the risk analysis and mitigation program framework, including a program-level risk register rolled up by site and system. Drive mitigation plans through prioritization, resourcing, scheduling, and verification of closure. Ensure risks and mitigations are visible, decision-ready, and actively managed, enabling informed risk acceptance or remediation decisions. Operations-to-Design Program Integration Own the operations-to-design bridge process at the program level. Ensure field changes, design deviations, and operational impacts identified by engineering or operations are documented, communicated to stakeholders, and tracked through resolution. Cross-Functional Coordination & Schedule Integration Serve as the central coordination point for capacity and risk initiatives across engineering, commissioning, design and construction, and site operations. Develop and maintain integrated schedules that align engineering execution with operational readiness milestones. Identify cross-discipline dependencies, conflicts, and resource constraints early and drive resolution. Standards, Playbooks & Continuous Improvement Partner with Critical Power and Mechanical Systems Specialists and Engineers to translate lessons learned into updated readiness playbooks. Standardize capacity readiness, turnover, and risk management processes across sites and regions, driving continual improvement of all owned programs. Project and Program Visibility Develop and execute methodology and processes to provide clear, concise reporting on all relevant metrics and program KPIs. Qualifications Education Bachelor's degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Facilities), Construction Management, Operations, or a related technical field; or equivalent practical experience in mission-critical infrastructure programs. Experience 7+ years of experience in mission-critical environments (data centers, critical facilities, high-availability infrastructure) in one or more of the following: operations, commissioning, engineering, design/construction interface, or reliability programs. 4+ years leading cross-functional programs or complex projects with multiple stakeholders, dependencies, and schedule integration. Demonstrated experience building or operating readiness stage gates / go-live criteria for new capacity, expansions, or major infrastructure changes. Proven track record driving risk identification, mitigation planning, and closure tracking (risk register ownership, mitigation verification, executive-ready risk posture). Technical & Domain Knowledge Working knowledge of mission-critical infrastructure concepts, including: Electrical distribution (UPS, switchgear, generators, protection/grounding concepts) Mechanical cooling and heat rejection (chilled water plants, CRAH/CRAC, towers/dry coolers, pumping strategies) BAS/BMS and controls sequence implications on operations Ability to interpret and synthesize technical inputs (commissioning findings, punch lists, readiness gaps, design deviations) into program actions and decisions. Program Management & Execution Strong capability in: Developing integrated schedules and managing interdependencies across engineering, commissioning, design and construction, and operations Establishing repeatable processes (templates, workflows, governance cadence) Managing program artifacts: stage gate checklists, RAID logs, risk registers, issue trackers, readiness dashboards Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a demonstrated ability to produce decision-ready executive summaries (capacity posture, readiness status, and risk exposure). Leadership Behaviors Proven ability to influence without direct authority and drive closure across multiple organizations. Bias for action, strong follow-through, and comfort escalating issues when readiness, risk, scope, or timelines are misaligned. Travel Ability to travel 25%–50%, based on business and program needs. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting multi-site / portfolio-scale capacity or reliability programs (regional or global). Familiarity with commissioning and readiness frameworks (e.g., Level 1–5 commissioning, IST/ISx, integrated systems testing, operational acceptance). Experience developing turnover documentation standards, operational readiness repositories, and training validation programs. Program/Project Management certification (PMP, PgMP, Agile/SAFe PM) or equivalent demonstrated mastery. Reliability or risk credentials/experience (FMEA facilitation, MOC/Change Management, operational risk frameworks). Advanced proficiency with planning and reporting tools (e.g., MS Project, Smartsheet, Power BI, SharePoint/Teams-based governance). CyrusOne is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status. CyrusOne provides reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and any other state or local laws. We will respond to requests for reasonable accommodations to assist you in applying for positions at CyrusOne, or to submit a resume.

title: AEM Technical Architect
jd_text: Job Description: The AEM Technical Architect will lead the design and delivery of enterprise Adobe Experience Manager implementations. This role partners with clients and cross-functional teams to create scalable, secure solutions, provide technical direction, and drive successful project execution. The position combines solution architecture, delivery leadership, and hands-on technical expertise . It is not a full-time development role, but the Architect must be able to troubleshoot complex issues, review implementation approaches, and contribute directly when needed. Essential Responsibilities Lead end-to-end AEM solution design and provide architectural direction throughout the project lifecycle. Partner with client stakeholders, business analysts, QA, lead developers, developers, DevOps teams, and third-party vendors to clarify requirements and align the implementation approach. Create and maintain architecture diagrams, technical solution designs, integration designs, and other project-level documentation. Design scalable and secure integrations between AEM and external platforms such as commerce, CRM, ERP, analytics, and marketing systems. Translate business and technical requirements into componentized AEM solutions, implementation patterns, and actionable direction for delivery teams. Guide lead developers and developers, review technical approaches and code, and help resolve complex delivery blockers. Assess wireframes and design mockups for feasibility, component reuse, responsive behavior, cross-browser compatibility, and accessibility. Design content workflows for creation, review, approval, and publishing within AEM, applying project-level governance and quality standards. Collaborate with DevOps teams on CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, release readiness, and change-management requirements. Participate in Agile ceremonies and monitor technical milestones, risks, dependencies, and delivery progress. Communicate complex technical recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences and influence alignment around the proposed solution. Provide technical effort estimates and planning input for AEM engagements. Mentor team members and share AEM architecture and implementation best practices. Adapt to new clients, technologies, and project needs as engagements evolve. Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience developing and delivering solutions with AEM Sites and AEM Assets. 3+ years of experience architecting enterprise-grade CMS or AEM implementations. Experience with AEM as a Cloud Service and/or Adobe Managed Services ; exposure to on-premises AEM environments is valuable. Strong experience with Java, HTTP, REST APIs, custom AEM components, templates, workflows, and integrations. Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and a modern front-end framework such as React or Vue. Demonstrated experience leading complex implementations involving multiple teams, technologies, or workstreams. Ability to create clear architecture diagrams and maintainable technical documentation. Hands-on ability to troubleshoot implementation issues, assess code and design decisions, and unblock delivery teams. Strong client-facing communication, presentation, collaboration, organization, and independent problem-solving skills. Experience working in Agile delivery environments and with source control, issue tracking, and documentation tools such as GitHub or Bitbucket, Jira, and Confluence. Preferred Qualifications Experience integrating AEM with Adobe Commerce, Salesforce Commerce, or another enterprise commerce platform. Exposure to Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign, or other Adobe Experience Cloud products. Experience supporting technical discovery, solution presentations, or pre-sales activities. Adobe AEM certification. Experience mentoring developers or providing career guidance. What Success Looks Like Clients and internal teams are aligned on a clear, feasible AEM solution direction. Architecture and technical decisions are documented, understood, and translated into executable delivery plans. Complex risks and blockers are surfaced early and resolved with sound technical judgment. Delivery teams receive practical guidance that supports quality, maintainability, scalability, and timely execution. The Architect can move between client conversations, technical design, and hands-on problem solving as project needs change . The annual salary range for this position is $113,000 - $158,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. Benefits available with this position include: • Medical, vision, and dental insurance, • Life insurance, • Short-term and long-term disability insurance, • 401k, • Flexible paid time off, • At least 15 paid holidays per year, • Paid sick and safe leave, and • Paid parental leave. Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com. To begin the application process, please click on the “Apply” button at the top of this job posting. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and qualified candidates will be contacted for next steps. At dentsu, we believe great work happens when we’re connected. Our way of working combines flexibility with in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. Employees who live within a commutable distance of one of our hub offices, currently located in Chicago, metro Detroit, Los Angeles, and New York City, are required and expected to work from the office three days per week (two days per week for employees based in Los Angeles). Dentsu may designate other Hub offices at any time. Those who live outside a commutable range may be designated as remote, depending on the role and business needs. Regardless of your work location, we expect our employees to be flexible to meet the needs of our Company and clients, which may include attendance in an office. Location: USA – Remote – Texas – Central Time Brand: Merkle Time Type: Full time Contract Type: Permanent Dentsu is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We do this without regard to race, color , national origin, sex , sexual orientation, gender identity, age, pregnancy, childbirth or related medical conditions, ancestry, physical or mental disability, marital status, political affiliation, religious practices and observances, citizenship status, genetic information, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. Dentsu is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to, among others, individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans. If you need an accommodation because of a disability to search and apply for a career opportunity with us, please send an e-mail to ApplicantAccommodations@dentsu.com by clicking on the link to let us know the nature of your accommodation request and your contact information. We are here to support you.

title: Solutions Integration Architect - SAP Ariba
jd_text: ABOUT ZIP Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before. The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA. Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. YOUR ROLE We’re looking for a Solutions Architect to help build the technical foundation that powers Zip’s ERP and integration ecosystem. This role focuses on internal technical enablement, navigating complex customer environments to architect the cleanest possible solutions, partnering closely with Product, and driving best-in-class standards across all of Zip’s integration workflows - with a specific focus on the SAP ecosystem. As Zip continues to scale rapidly across enterprise customers like Coinbase, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Snowflake, and Databricks, your impact will be foundational: creating reusable integration assets, defining standards of how the Zip product interacts with external systems. YOU WILL You’ll work closely with our Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) teams while reporting to Engineering to design, maintain, and iterate on Zip-owned ERP and integration templates that power scalable, repeatable customer implementations. Your work will directly influence how hundreds of future implementations are delivered, raising the technical bar for both our EPD teams and our customer-facing technical consultant organization. - Architect & standardize SAP integrations: Design, maintain, and iterate on Zip’s core SAP (ECC and S/4HANA) and Ariba integration templates, ensuring they deliver scalable, repeatable, and robust customer implementations. - Bridge product & the field: Work closely with Engineering, Product, and Design (EPD) to ensure integration templates stay perfectly aligned with core product architecture, field insights, and emerging customer needs. - Turn nuance into scale: Analyze complex customer implementations to identify reusable data mapping patterns and system nuances, converting bespoke solutions into standardized internal assets. - Support pre-sales engineering: Partner with account teams during pre-sales to design and vet integration architectures, ensuring prospective customers are set up for smooth, best-practice deployments. - Drive technical implementation excellence: Define, document, and champion technical solution consulting best practices, raising the technical bar and driving consistency across all implementations. - Become a Multi-ERP expert: Leverage your existing SAP, P2P, and module expertise (MM/FI) to build deep fluency across additional ERP ecosystems, ultimately becoming the ultimate subject matter expert on integration architecture, data models, and Zip’s App Studio. - Build for permanent scale: Approach every technical challenge with an engineering mindset - designing and executing a solution thoroughly once so that future implementations happen effortlessly. You balance high-level architectural design with a willingness to dive directly into API configurations and template modifications to get the job done right. QUALIFICATIONS - 6+ years of hands-on experience delivering integrations with SAP ERP environments (ECC, S/4HANA) or procurement platforms (Ariba). - Strong foundational knowledge of core SAP business processes and data models within Materials Management (MM) and Financials (FI). - Familiarity with standard SAP integration methods, such as IDocs, BAPI/RFC, OData APIs, or SAP BTP/CPI. - Familiarity with iPaaS tools is preferred, but we welcome candidates with strong core integration logic who can learn new platform tools quickly. - Experience working with XML / REST based endpoints and standard authentication protocols. - Past ERP implementation, integration, configuration or administration experience is required. - Ability to translate highly technical information for audiences with varying degrees of technical knowledge. - Comfortable working with API documentation. - Comfortable testing and troubleshooting integration errors. - Able to understand customer requirements and document that information quickly, with little oversight - A continual learner and open to learning new technologies that Zip may integrate with in the future. - Strong communication skills. - Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive. - Experience working with product and engineering teams. - Process-driven with a strong bias toward continuous improvement; you consistently look for opportunities to make systems better than you found them through systematic improvement. The salary range for this role is $135,000 - $200,000 OTE. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise. PERKS & BENEFITS At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work. - 📈 Start-up equity - 🦷 Full health, vision & dental coverage - 🌴 Flexible PTO - 💻 Apple equipment plus home office budget - 💸 401k plan We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!
