title: Procurement Analyst
jd_text: WHO WE ARE Vultr is on a mission to make high-performance cloud infrastructure easy to use, affordable, and locally accessible for enterprises and AI innovators around the world. With 33 global cloud data center locations, Vultr is trusted by hundreds of thousands of active customers across 185 countries for its flexible, scalable, global Cloud Compute, Cloud GPU, Bare Metal, and Cloud Storage solutions. In December 2024 Vultr announced an equity financing at a $3.5 billion valuation. Founded by David Aninowsky and self-funded for over a decade, Vultr has grown to become the world’s largest privately-held cloud infrastructure company. VULTR CARES - 100% company-paid insurance premiums for employee medical, dental, and vision plans - 401(k) plan with 100% match up to 4%, immediate vesting - Professional Development Reimbursement of $2,500 each year - 11 Holidays plus Paid Time Off Accrual and Rollover Plan - Increased PTO at 3-year and 10-year anniversaries; 1 month paid sabbatical every 5 years; Anniversary Bonus each year - $500 stipend for remote office setup in first year, $400 each following year - Internet reimbursement up to $75 per month - Gym membership reimbursement up to $50 per month - Company paid Wellable subscription JOIN VULTR The Procurement Analyst will support the procurement function at a high-growth neocloud company by managing vendor data, analyzing spend, and driving process efficiency. This role is critical in enabling data-driven procurement decisions that support our infrastructure scaling goals. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES - Analyze procurement data to identify cost savings, supplier consolidation opportunities, and process inefficiencies across hardware, software, and services categories - Maintain and update procurement databases, vendor records, and contract repositories to ensure accuracy and accessibility - Support RFP/RFQ processes by collecting and comparing vendor proposals, pricing, and technical specifications - Track and report on key procurement KPIs including spend under management, savings realized, and purchase order cycle times - Coordinate with Finance on purchase requisition approvals, invoice reconciliation, and budget tracking - Assist in supplier onboarding, due diligence documentation, and performance scorecards - Develop and maintain procurement dashboards and reporting using ERP and analytics tools - Support contract management activities including tracking renewal dates, compliance milestones, and deliverable schedules - Collaborate with technical teams to translate hardware and infrastructure requirements into actionable procurement specifications QUALIFICATIONS - Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or a related field - 2–4 years of experience in procurement, supply chain, or strategic sourcing - Proficiency with procurement or ERP systems (e.g., Coupa, SAP Ariba, NetSuite) - Strong analytical skills with experience in Excel, Google Sheets, or BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker) - Understanding of hardware procurement in data center or hyperscale environments is a plus - Detail-oriented with strong organizational and time management skills - Excellent written and verbal communication skills PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth technology or infrastructure company - Familiarity with GPU, networking, or data center hardware supply chains - CPSM or CSCP certification in progress or completed Soft Skills: - Attention to detail with the ability to manage large data sets. - Strong communication and collaboration skills. - Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. Compensation $75,000 - $85,000 Final compensation will vary depending on years of experience, background/skill set, location, and applicable laws. title: Payment Integrity Program Manager
jd_text: Job Description A bit about this role: The Payment Integrity Inpatient Program Manager is responsible for overseeing assigned inpatient Payment Integrity programs, including audit, appeals, quality, and review processes across internal teams, offshore staff augmentation, and external vendors. This role is heavily focused on ensuring audit accuracy, timeliness, coding and clinical quality, regulatory compliance, consistency, and defensibility across all assigned program areas. The Program Manager is accountable not only for the quality of audit determinations but also for ensuring audits are reviewed within SLA and that inventory is actively managed to prevent backlogs. The Program Manager partners closely with leadership and operational support teams to ensure audit workflows are executed effectively and on time while maintaining strong oversight of audit quality, turnaround performance, dispute outcomes, vendor performance, and adherence to organizational and regulatory standards. Your Responsibilities and Impact will include: Perform complex and escalated inpatient Payment Integrity audits, including clinical validation, DRG coding validation, readmission, and hospital bill audit reviews, and provide clear, defensible audit rationale and determinations. Provide guidance and oversight to internal staff (offshore and stateside)) and external vendors, managing calibration sessions, feedback loops, education, and ongoing quality monitoring to ensure compliance and adherence to program expectations Develop and maintain program-specific training materials, audit guidance, review standards, and supporting documentation Perform quality reviews and trend analysis to ensure coding, clinical, and audit findings are accurate, defensible, and aligned with regulatory, contractual, and organizational requirements Monitor program metrics, dispute trends, and vendor results, partnering with leadership to identify root causes, address quality concerns, and drive continuous improvement efforts Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to resolve complex audit, coding, clinical, and escalation-related issues, serving as the primary subject matter expert for assigned program areas Support dispute and appeals management activities, including escalation review, audit rationale review, and corrective action planning Support the implementation of new audit concepts, review methodologies, and program enhancements to align with evolving business and regulatory needs Required skills and experience: 2-3 years of experience in healthcare audit, Payment Integrity, coding review, clinical documentation review, or compliance Strong clinical and inpatient coding knowledge required; CCS, RHIA, RHIT, RN, or equivalent inpatient coding/clinical validation experience required. Demonstrated expertise in inpatient DRG coding and validation strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience with inpatient DRG assignment and validation, including ICD-10-CM coding, principal and secondary diagnosis assignment, MCC/CC identification, POA indicators, and inpatient clinical documentation review, as well as severity of illness/risk of mortality concepts and readmission logic. Demonstrated experience reviewing medical records to ensure audit accuracy, coding/clinical correctness, compliance, and defensibility of determinations Experience operating within structured audit programs, including applying defined criteria, documenting rationale, and ensuring consistency and quality of audit outcomes Ability to interpret clinical and/or coding documentation to support audit decisions and resolve documentation gaps or discrepancies Experience collaborating across clinical, coding, audit, and operational teams in a complex healthcare environment Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess audit trends, root causes, and documentation gaps impacting program performance and quality outcomes Strong operational discipline and the ability to stay organized amidst a wide variety of responsibilities Proven experience in training payment integrity audits Desired skills and experience: Bachelor’s Degree Strong leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills to effectively engage internal and external stakeholders Experience managing offshore vendors Ability to handle multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment Curiosity and hands-on experience with AI tools, automation, or LLM-based workflows in operational settings #LI-remote Salary range: ​$73,000 - 125,000 annually The pay range listed for this position is the range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at the time of the posting. Once the interview process begins, your talent partner will provide additional information on the compensation for the role, along with additional information on our total rewards package. The actual base salary offered will depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job. Our Total Rewards package includes: Employer sponsored health, dental and vision plan with low or no premium Generous paid time off $100 monthly mobile or internet stipend Stock options for all employees Bonus eligibility for all roles excluding Director and above; Commission eligibility for Sales roles Parental leave program 401K program And more.... *Our total rewards package is for full time employees only. title: Marketplace Operations Manager II
jd_text: Job Title: Marketplace Operations Manager II Job Location (Remote): Remote, USA About the Company Wheel is evolving the traditional care ecosystem by equipping the nation's most innovative companies with a premier platform to deliver high-quality virtual care at scale. We offer proven strategies and cutting-edge technologies to foster consumer engagement, build brand loyalty, and maximize return on investment. Wheel solutions include configurable virtual care programs, an intuitive consumer interface, and access to a nationwide network of board-certified clinicians. Discover how Wheel is transforming the future of healthcare by visiting www.wheel.com http://www.wheel.com. ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Marketplace Operations Manager II to own visit delivery for a defined set of Wheel's client programs. This is an operator's role for someone who wants day-to-day ownership of critical business outcomes - and can carry that accountability even when some levers live with peer functions. You'll take on the complex, ambiguous problems that come with scaling a fast-growing telehealth marketplace - from stabilizing a roster through demand volatility, to leading cross-functional projects that shape how Marketplace Operations scales next. You will own the visit delivery SLA commitments, program-level consult cost performance, and the roster health for your clients. Separate functions on the team own overall clinician supply forecasting, clinician performance management, and scheduling - freeing you up to optimize their use within your programs. This is a role for someone who wants to run marketplace operations for key clients end-to-end: launching and configuring new client programs, writing the operational playbooks your programs run on, and deploying incentive spend within guardrails - while trusting peer functions to own adjacent responsibilities in order for you to maintain a singular, maniacal focus on client performance. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Program Performance and Delivery - Own marketplace performance outcomes (contractual and otherwise) for your assigned client programs: SLA attainment, program-level clinician pay cost, and roster/staffing health. - Own roster composition and staffing strategy for your programs, building and adjusting rosters to ensure SLA through client growth, churn, and short-term volatility. - Own operational data analytics and reporting for your programs - pulling and interrogating utilization, breach-pattern, and profitability data yourself and turning it into recommendations and actions - Own the operating rhythm and upward performance visibility for your programs: recurring performance reviews of SLA, utilization, and cost that turns into actions. - Partner with the Capacity Planner to understand near-term volatility and how it may affect client demand (ie demand surges, modality changes, etc) and own the operational response for your programs (escalation thresholds, incentive levers, roster mix) to keep the program on track. Cost and Incentives - Optimize program-level clinician pay cost and deploy consult incentive spend within a defined budget. - Own the cost plan for your programs and be accountable to variance - partner with the Director of Marketplace on expected cost-per-consult, and keep your lever costs calibrated so you know how to deploy your incentives appropriately. Real-Time Response and Agent Oversight - Author the real-time escalation and response playbook your programs run on: thresholds, approved corrective actions, escalation triggers. Real-time monitoring and AI agents execute against the playbook you write, and you refine how they act on your programs as their capabilities grow. - Review how the agents act on your programs - audit their decisions for quality, catch policy drift or mistakes early, and feed corrections back into the playbook and the agent logic. You're the human-in-the-loop that keeps automated responses trustworthy on your book. - Partner with clinician management peers to relay clinician performance observations that impact your programs and to identify roster improvements that will drive your client performance. Client Launches and Partnership - Partner with Customer Success as the operational counterpart on the client's commercial relationship - supporting quarterly business reviews and the real-world story behind client performance. - Own launch supply-readiness with Provider Operations and the Capacity Planner - ensuring clinicians are credentialed, licensed, and activated in the right states, at the volume the program needs, before go-live. - Lead new-client implementation - configuration and setup - as part of cross functional onboarding teams, and own expansions for programs you already run. - Support strategic projects across Marketplace Operations as they arise. WHO YOU ARE - An operator with experience working in fast-paced, high-demand environments - someone who digs into the details to find root cause, spots broken or inefficient processes, and builds the fix rather than just flagging the problem. - Experience owning end-to-end operational performance in a marketplace, logistics, or two-sided platform environment (delivery, rideshare, staffing, workforce management) - direct accountability for SLA, throughput, or cost. - Strategic thinker who connects day-to-day program performance to the bigger picture - you can zoom out from a single roster or escalation to spot the pattern worth fixing structurally, and zoom back in to execute it. - A strong cross-functional partner and team player - you know how to work through peer teams and different personalities to drive your program's outcomes, even when you don't own every lever yourself. - Strong data fluency. You pull and interrogate your own SLA, completion, utilization, and cost-to-plan data and drive decisions from it - hands-on with SQL, Looker, and Excel - rather than waiting for someone to translate it for you. - A direct, clear communicator who authors and revises the procedures your programs run on - escalation playbooks, response plans, launch runbooks - rather than only following ones someone else wrote. NICE TO HAVE Don't let these stand in your way—they’re just added bonuses! If you meet most of the core requirements, we encourage you to apply. - Exposure to multi-state licensure, credentialing, or other regulated-workforce dynamics. - Experience launching or configuring new client programs in a marketplace or platform business. - Healthcare, telehealth, or regulated-workforce experience. - Marketplace or platform experience. title: Jr. Quality Systems Specialist
jd_text: POSITION OVERVIEW: The Jr. Quality Systems Specialist (JQSS) is responsible for assisting with the implementation and/or usage of assigned internal or external software applications. title: Senior Order to Cash Operations Manager
jd_text: ABOUT ZIP Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before. The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA. Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups. YOUR ROLE As a Senior Order to Cash (OTC) Operations Manager at Zip, you will own and scale the end-to-end OTC function for recurring subscriptions and consumption revenue models. You will lead cross-functional initiatives and work directly with senior leadership to drive operational transformation, optimize cash flow, and build OTC system architecture for Zip’s future growth. This is a hands-on, senior individual contributor role with broad exposure across Finance, Sales, Deal Desk, Product, and Engineering. The ideal candidate is an experienced operator and strong day-to-day executor who would rather build than maintain, and who is comfortable designing and deploying automation and AI tools to support Zip’s revenue growth. WHAT YOU’LL DO - Own the order to cash lifecycle end to end, from order creation through invoicing, collections, and cash application, ensuring accuracy, timely delivery, and adherence to contractual terms. - Drive customer collections: oversee dunning processes, monitor AR aging, and conduct direct outreach to customers with past-due accounts, working with Sales and Customer Success to resolve disputes and escalations. - Lead new billing and revenue system implementations, driving accounting requirements and keeping cross-functional stakeholders aligned on scope and timing. - Identify and deploy automation and AI-based workflows across invoicing and collections to reduce process cycle times. - Collaborate with GTM, Deal Desk, and Product on new SKU launches and validate that billing and accounting systems are ready before the launch date. - Manage the month-end close for bookings and billings, working in lockstep with Deal Strategy and Operations teams to ensure seamless handoff to Revenue Accounting. - Partner with Engineering and Product to ensure usage data is captured and reported into our billing systems accurately. - Proactively monitor and implement strategies to maintain strong collections, optimize cash flow and minimize bad debt exposure. - Serve as the primary point of contact for AR and billing external audit matters. - Develop documentation, playbooks, and standard operating procedures (SOPs) for the order-to-cash function. WHAT YOU’LL BRING Required - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field. CPA is a plus. - 8+ years of experience in billing, accounts receivable, revenue accounting, or order-to-cash, including time at a high-growth technology company. - Experience managing hybrid revenue models (recurring subscription + consumption). - Advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets for reconciliation and data analysis. - Familiarity using Snowflake queries for data retrieval and analysis; SQL proficiency is a plus. - Strong collaboration and communication skills, with a track record of partnering effectively with cross-functional stakeholders. - Working knowledge of ASC 606 revenue recognition principles and application to billing. - Experience building AI-driven workflows involving multiple data sources and/or multiple system integration points. - Comfortable performing detailed, hands-on operational work while owning strategic initiatives. - Track record of building or overhauling finance processes and systems, with sound judgment on what to build now and what to defer. - Familiarity with NetSuite, Salesforce, and modern billing and collections tooling. The salary range for this role is $145,000 - $210,000. The salary for this position is determined based on a variety of job-related factors that may include location, relevant experience, education, or particular skills and expertise. PERKS & BENEFITS At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work. - 📈 Start-up equity - 🦷 100% health, vision & dental coverage options - 🌴 Flexible PTO - 🏋️‍♀️ ClassPass membership - 🚍 Monthly commuter benefit - 🚠 Team building events & happy hours - 💻 Home office stipend - 🛜 Phone/internet reimbursement - 🍼 Paid parental leave - 🧑‍🧑‍🧒‍🧒 Fertility stipend - 💸 401k plan - 🤖 Unlimited AI token usage We're looking to hire Zipsters and that means hiring people who take ownership, communicate openly, have an underdog mindset, and are excited to increase the pace of innovation for every business in the world. We encourage all candidates to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match up to our job description. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workspace where everyone (regardless of age, religion, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, and more) feels like they belong. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: RevOps Systems Analyst
jd_text: IMPORTANT: Please be aware, scammers may try to impersonate Zello by reaching out regarding job opportunities. We will never ask you for bank account information, checks, or other sensitive information as part of our hiring process. All correspondence will come from the zello.com email domain. If you’re unsure, please email recruiting@zello.com with questions. ABOUT ZELLO Zello is a voice-first communication platform, powered by our industry-leading push-to-talk technology, to improve collaboration and productivity for desk-less workers. With over 175+ million users, we’re the #1 rated push-to-talk app in the world, delivering 9 billion (yes, with a B) messages a month. At Zello, our company values are at the heart of what we do everyday. We’re proud to serve the frontline, we’re privileged to connect people in times of crisis across the globe, and we’re honored to support first responders. And this is where you come in. Zello keeps frontline and deskless teams connected through voice-first, push-to-talk communication. Behind that business sits HubSpot, and today it runs on workarounds: automations patched by hand, integrations that break quietly, and data quality nobody owns end to end. This role exists to own the CRM as a system, so that revenue decisions rest on data people trust and the AI automations we are building can actually run on it. You would be one of two people on the Revenue Operations team, reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer. The other seat owns forecasting and analysis. You own the systems those numbers come out of. AFTER A SUCCESSFUL FIRST YEAR, YOU WILL HAVE - Inventoried and rebuilt the HubSpot workflows and automations the business depends on, each one documented with its owner and its dependencies, and retired the manual patches holding them together. - Established a CRM data quality standard that holds: required fields defined by object and stage, a weekly exception report people act on, and stale or incomplete records down to an agreed threshold. - Rebuilt and instrumented the integrations between HubSpot and the rest of the stack, so data moves without manual reconciliation and a failed sync raises an alert instead of being discovered three weeks later. - Made the CRM solid enough to build AI on, with at least two AI-driven go-to-market automations running in production against HubSpot data and no human correcting them in the loop. - Taken ownership of the RevOps intake queue with a published response standard, so Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing get answers without escalating to leadership. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Own HubSpot as the administrator of record: workflows, objects and properties, lifecycle stages, list architecture, permissions, and sequences. - Own the data flowing in and out of the CRM, including the integrations with the website, Gong, Aircall, billing, and our BI layer in Omni. - Find the root cause when data goes wrong, and build the recurring audit that catches it next time rather than cleaning it up by hand again. - Build and maintain automations with APIs, webhooks, and light scripting where native HubSpot tooling runs out. - Partner with the AI and Data team on the data structures and field integrity that AI-driven go-to-market automations depend on. - Run the RevOps request queue for Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing, and decide what gets fixed properly versus worked around. - Hold the data standard when a team wants an exception, and explain the tradeoff in terms of what it costs downstream. - Support lead and list operations, from event intake through upload, so records enter the CRM clean. WHO YOU ARE - You have administered HubSpot hands-on in a revenue operations context, and you can walk through a workflow architecture you built and what you would do differently now. - You bring 2 to 4 years in RevOps, SalesOps, or CRM operations, ideally in B2B SaaS. - You fix the cause rather than the symptom, and you build the check that catches the problem next time instead of doing the cleanup twice. - You have connected a CRM to other systems through APIs, webhooks, or an integration platform, and you know how those connections fail. - You ship the fix that solves this quarter's problem, and you can tell the difference between a system that needs redesigning and one that needs a working solution by Friday. - You hold a standard with people who outrank you, and you say no to the exception without making an enemy of the person who asked. - You notice the broken thing before someone files a ticket about it, and you finish migrations rather than leaving half-cut automations behind. - You use AI in your own work and can say specifically where it saves you time and where you stop trusting it. THIS ROLE IS NOT - A forecasting or analytics seat. Pipeline analysis, forecast modeling, and executive reporting belong to the Senior Revenue Operations Analyst. You make the data those rest on trustworthy. - A management role. This is a hands-on individual contributor seat on a two-person team. - A ticket-taking administrator seat. You are expected to decide what gets fixed permanently, not just service the queue. - A data engineering or platform role. Warehouse architecture, dbt, and the AI platform are owned by the AI and Data team, and you partner with them rather than owning that layer. We hire for potential, passion for our mission, and a knack for solving difficult problems over checking every qualification box. We have competitive pay, equity with significant upside, and intentionally design our benefits to encourage healthy and well-balanced employees, flexible schedules and time off. We even offer a sabbatical after every five years of service so you’re able to pursue and enjoy what matters most to you. And of course, we wouldn’t be a technology company without a ping-pong table and free snacks in our break room. Join us! Zello provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. All Zello personnel are required to comply with defined security, privacy, and compliance requirements applicable to their role along with requirements that are applicable to all Zello personnel.

title: Senior Product Manager II - Vendor Spend
jd_text: About Us: Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting. Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less. The Opportunity – Senior Product Manager II, Vendor Spend (Remote - USA / Canada) Do you love product problems where real money moves, mistakes have consequences, and a better workflow is worth millions in time and trust? Are you a self-starter who thrives on technical depth, systems thinking, and genuine customer stakes? Then this role is for you. We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own Vendor Spend: the vendor-payment layer of Wrapbook. This role owns how production companies pay their vendors — every payment method, the workflows around each payment, and the tracking and reporting that show customers exactly what's been paid. Your mandate is to broaden and speed up how vendors get paid, push toward straight-through processing, and open up net-new ways for productions to spend — while keeping every dollar accurate, compliant, and fraud-resistant. This is one of the higher-leverage roles in the product org. Vendor payments touch cash flow, fraud and AML exposure, tax reporting, and the general ledger, and they sit at the crossroads of banking, accounting, and go-to-market. You'll own a domain with high technical complexity, a large cross-team surface area, and a direct line to customer and business outcomes. You'll partner with a tenured engineering team, an experienced designer, and be a key product voice across the AP & Payments group and the teams upstream and downstream of you. What You'll Do: - Own the roadmap and vision for Vendor Spend — aligning customer needs and business priorities into a clear, sequenced plan you can defend, and defining the success metrics that prove it's working (adoption, cost and fraud reduction, revenue signals). - Expand and streamline how productions pay AP vendors — ACH (moving toward faster settlement), checks, direct-to-bank processing, card payments, and international — reducing time-to-payment and pushing toward true straight-through processing. - Lead the expense-management bet, a meaningful 0→1 opportunity: Wrapbook-issued spend/purchasing cards and virtual AP cards for invoice payments, including issuance, controls, and how card spend flows back into accounting. - Advocate for accuracy, compliance, and fraud protection. Positive pay and check-fraud prevention, ACH transaction screening and AML controls, and vendor tax reporting (1099) are core to the domain, not afterthoughts. - Partner with our banking infrastructure team on payment rails, defining clear service boundaries so vendor-payment workflows and the underlying bank transport evolve independently without surprises. - Keep vendor payments correct in the ledger, partnering with Accounting so payments and their reconciliation flow cleanly into production accounting. - Triage and prioritize competing demands from across the company — other product teams, Client Operations, Sales, Finance, Risk, Legal, and Support all touch this domain — managing them as part of your roadmap rather than as interruptions. - Use AI tools daily to accelerate your workflow — from discovery and analysis to writing, code comprehension, and prototyping. We expect our PMs to be builders, not just strategists. What You'll Have: - 5+ years of product management experience in a SaaS, fintech, or similarly complex technical environment. - A track record of measurable outcomes, not just shipped features. You can point to products you drove that moved a real number — adoption, new market or segment access, cost or fraud reduction, revenue — and explain your specific contribution. - Domain proximity to money movement. Background in accounts payable, vendor/B2B payments, card issuance, or accounting is strongly preferred, so you can go deep quickly rather than ramping from zero on how funds and ledgers actually work. - A technical orientation. You reason with engineering about systems, data models, integrations, fund flows, and failure modes without heavy hand-holding. - Active, daily AI usage in your PM workflow — not experimental and not just ChatGPT. You use LLMs, AI-assisted coding tools, and AI workflows as core parts of how you ship, and can articulate specifically how AI has changed your PM work and where it's headed. - Experience owning products with high cross-functional surface area, where other teams and stakeholders depend on the systems and workflows you own. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a bias toward action, balanced against the compliance and quality bar a payments product demands. - Comfort with ambiguity — able to dive deep and become a subject-matter expert in an unfamiliar, technically complex domain. - Excellent written and verbal communication. Clear, structured, decision-oriented writing that keeps engineering and cross-functional partners aligned. - Data self-sufficiency. You independently pull and interpret data using tools like SQL, Pendo, Omni, or Snowflake to define, track, and measure product success. - A growth mindset, and deep empathy for the customers and operators who live in these workflows every day. Extra Points If You Have: - Payments & domain depth: hands-on experience with AP / vendor payments, B2B money movement, or card issuance — including payment rails (ACH/NACHA, checks, positive pay, direct-to-bank, processor integrations like Stripe) and the tradeoffs in fund flows, settlement timing, and reconciliation. Ideally in fintech, payroll, accounting/ERP, or entertainment/production. - 0→1 experience standing up a new payments or card capability under real ambiguity. - Risk & compliance: fraud/AML controls, transaction screening, or tax reporting (1099) in a financial product. - Scale-up experience at a high-growth SaaS company, maturing product process while keeping speed. Why Join Us At Wrapbook, creativity meets technology — and not just in the product. In addition to a competitive salary and all the benefits you can expect from a fast-growing technology company, you’ll get access to a team of creative problem solvers and the chance to see your contributions make large impacts. Benefits include: - Unlimited Paid Time Off - Work from anywhere in Canada and USA - Health and Dental benefits - Up to $1,500 USD/ $2,025 CAD towards IT set up for your home - Up to 2% matching RRSP / 401K - Learning and Development opportunities - Up to $50 USD/ $67.50 CAD towards Internet/Cell phone service Our Pledge to Fostering an Inclusive and Safe Workplace: Wrapbook pledges to be a harassment- and discrimination-free space for everyone, regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, nationality, neurotype, personal appearance, political affiliation, professional background, race, religion, or sexual identity or orientation. Apply Now Have we got your attention? Submit your application today and a member of our Talent team will be in touch with you shortly! #LI-Remote

title: Manager of Accounting & Financial Planning
jd_text: About Us: Since 1980, DynaTen Corporation (a Comfort Systems USA Company) has delivered high-quality Commercial Construction and Service Solutions across the greater North Texas market. We partner with our clients to provide technical expertise and high-level execution on every project. As a result, DynaTen is a trusted provider of HVAC, Plumbing, and Building Automation Controls solutions. Our culture is built on accountability, teamwork, and a commitment to developing our people. We take pride in promoting from within, supporting both field and office teams, and delivering results the right way. We offer strong long-term career opportunities, excellent benefits, and a positive, team-oriented work environment. Position Summary The Manager of Accounting & Financial Planning is responsible for leading the financial planning, reporting, analysis, and operational finance functions of the organization. This role partners closely with executive leadership, operations, project management, and accounting teams to drive profitability, improve financial performance, strengthen internal controls, and support strategic decision-making. This position reports to the Vice President of Finance. Principal Duties and Responsibilities Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual financial planning and forecasting processes. Analyze financial results and provide actionable recommendations to executive leadership. Develop financial models to support strategic initiatives, capital investments, and operational decisions. Monitor key financial and operational performance indicators and communicate results to leadership. Partner with Operations, Project Executives, Project Managers, and Project Accountants to monitor project financial performance. Review project cost-to-complete forecasts, analyze project profitability, and identify project risks, margin erosion, or cost overruns. Oversee Work-in-Progress (WIP) reporting and revenue recognition compliance. Review and analyze Schedules of Values (SOVs), progress billings, pay applications, subcontract agreements, lien waivers, retainage, and subcontractor compliance documentation. Partner with Operations and Project Management teams to identify and mitigate commercial, contractual, and financial risk. Lead preparation of annual operating budgets, quarterly forecasts, department-level forecasts, and project-level financial forecasts. Perform variance analysis and communicate budget-to-actual results, cash flow impacts, and working capital considerations. Ensure accurate and timely preparation of financial and management reports. Support month-end and year-end close, audit preparation, GAAP compliance, company accounting policies, and internal control monitoring. Coordinate internal and external audits, including financial statement audits, SOX or internal control reviews, insurance audits, and customer audits. Serve as a liaison between auditors, accounting teams, operations personnel, and executive leadership. Evaluate existing financial and operational processes and recommend improvements that strengthen compliance, reduce risk, and improve reporting integrity. Supervise and mentor Finance Analysts, Project Accountants, and other finance personnel as assigned. Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, professional development, and standardized reporting practices. title: Account Manager, Supply Chain ESG
jd_text: ACCOUNT MANAGER, SUPPLY CHAIN ESG Location: United States (East Coast) ABOUT WORLDLY Worldly is the world’s most comprehensive impact intelligence platform — delivering real data to businesses on impacts within their supply chain. Worldly is trusted by 40,000 global brands, retailers, and manufacturers to provide the single source of ESG intelligence they need to accelerate business and industry transformation. Through strategic and meaningful customer relationships, Worldly provides key insights into supplier performance, product impact, trends analysis, and compliance. When a company wants to positively improve their environmental and societal impact, we enable that systemic shift. Backed by a dedicated global team of individuals aligned by values, Worldly proudly operates as a public benefit corporation with backing from mission-aligned investors. Want to learn more? Read our story http://worldly.io/about. ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY In this role, you’ll work as a key contributor within Worldly’s Growth Team to manage the ongoing development and implementation of a comprehensive Accounts program for Worldly customers. These companies face urgent sustainability improvement mandates across massive supply chains, and your team will ensure the Worldly platform is an indispensable resource in helping them meet these challenges. Most of these accounts have historically not had consistent engagement with our accounts team, only receiving reactive support as needed. You will be responsible for evolving the relationship with these accounts, proactively engaging them to ensure they are realizing the full value of the Worldly portfolio of solutions. Your primary strategic focus will be to drive consistent and sustainable growth across your book of business. This role reports to the SVP, Growth. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Consistently meet account growth targets, both for revenue and engagement - Serve as the primary point of contact for large portfolio of Worldly client accounts, fostering deeper relationships to help them realize the value of their Worldly investment - Manage a pipeline of opportunities and reliably forecast revenue on a weekly basis from three primary sources: renewal, upsell, and associated (account-influenced indirect revenue) - Contribute to the ongoing development of Worldly’s Accounts program, relentless seeking process improvements and collaborating with peers to implement scalable solutions - Develop deep working relationship with Product and Partnerships teams, to integrate new in-house and third party offerings into the Account Management program WE'D LIKE TO SEE The successful candidate will have the following minimum qualifications: - Bachelor's degree preferred, but proven success in a similar account management role is more important - Prior experience collaborating closely with teammates in a remote work environment - Proven track record of achieving revenue-based targets - Experience in a technology/SaaS organization or related context, working with a high volume of B2B relationships - Committed to sustainability as evidenced by your professional or life experience - This is a critical factor: Enthusiastic about fast-paced environments and comfortable navigating ambiguity, consistently seeking to add value beyond the scope of your job description - Someone of mental grit and innate empathy: When the going gets tough, you bring a sense of levity and perspective to the table. You’re an empathetic human who values the same in others. WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU - Comprehensive benefits offerings. 90% employee premium and 75% spouse/dependent premium covered by Worldly. - Company-sponsored 401k with up to 4% match. - Incentive Stock Options - 100% Parental Paid Leave - Unlimited PTO - 13 company holidays LIFE AT WORLDLY Our team is motivated to transform the way products are made. By helping our customers succeed in a new era of sustainable production, we can build technology that makes a difference on a planetary level. Our team represents over 15 countries and brings unique experiences from technology to farming to the table. Surround yourself with kind, enthusiastic, and dedicated people who put collaboration and growth at the center of our shared goals. Benefits and Perks - Earn a competitive salary and performance-based bonuses. Get healthcare, retirement matching, and equity for US employees. - Use the office stipend to get the supplies you need—combat Zoom fatigue with no-meeting Fridays. - Flexible time off. Take the time you need to recharge. Our culture encourages team members to explore and rest to be their best selves. - We're remote, not lonely. Join the culture committee, coffee chats, book club, or a variety of other interest groups. EQUITY STATEMENT We believe reflecting the diversity of those we strive to serve is essential. True innovation happens when everyone has room at the table, including the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel. We’re dedicated to building a culturally and experientially diverse team that leads and works with empathy and respect. COMPENSATION OVERVIEW Annual Base Salary: - US: $110,000 USD Annual Incentive Bonus Program Comprehensive Benefits Package *Final compensation details will be determined based on a wide variety of factors, including experience and location. title: Lead Media Systems Engineer (Overnight Shift Supervisor)
jd_text: Job Posting Title: Lead Media Systems Engineer (Overnight Shift Supervisor) Req ID: 10142531 Job Description: **This position must sit onsite in our Woodlands, TX technology office** **Please note the hours on this position are Monday-Friday, 3PM-12AM** Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future. Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business globally. The team marries technology with creativity to build world-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive velocity, innovation, and scalability for our businesses. We are Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers. We work with every part of The Walt Disney Company’s media portfolio to advance the technological foundation and consumer media touch points serving millions of people around the world. Here are a few reasons why we think you’d love working here: 1. Building the future of Disney’s media: Our Technologists are designing and building the products and platforms that will power our media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. 2. Reach, Scale & Impact: More than ever, Disney’s technology and products serve as a signature doorway for fans' connections with the company’s brands and stories. Disney+. Hulu. ESPN. ABC. ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally. 3. Innovation: We develop and implement groundbreaking products and techniques that shape industry norms, and solve complex and distinctive technical problems. Content Platforms & Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The global team also plays a critical role as the primary collaboration point for Product & Technology with Disney’s EMEA, APAC, and LATAM regional business teams. Job Summary: Disney Media Engineers have a clear charter: to transform the capability and flexibility of how Disney acquires, produces, and distributes content worldwide, all while ensuring the highest levels of quality, efficiency, and resiliency. Disney Media Engineers often find themselves at the crossroads between hardware and software based technology and must possess a comprehensive theoretical and practical understanding of the technology that powers the generation, monetization, and distribution of all forms of consumer- facing linear and digital video/audio content. Responsibility includes numerous systems such as Playout Technology, Studios, Production Control Rooms, Remote Production, Post-Production, Contribution/Distribution Systems, Networking, Cloud Compute, Production Software and Virtual Environment and more. The Lead Media Systems Engineer is an expert engineer in several disciplines related to the acquisition, production, or distribution of media content. They are well-versed in multiple technical standards and have hands-on experience in both the sustainment and design/build of production systems. The Lead Media Systems Engineer is part of a tiered sustainment model where incidents are escalated from a shared Operations team (tier 1) to the Media Engineer I’s, II’s and Sr. Media Engineer (tier 2), Lead Media Engineer (tier 3) and beyond. They are the heart of the sustainment efforts in the technology they lead. The Lead Media Engineer will interface with both external and internal partners to ensure their technical areas are operating with peak efficiency and reliability. Lead Media Engineers are also focused heavily on the design/build of their areas of expertise, often advancing innovative technology to maintain Disney’s competitive technical edge. Lead Media Engineers perform beyond the technical to truly understand the businesses that benefit from our technology and make decisions and recommendations based on the complete business, operational and technical outlook, and requirements. Responsibilities and Duties of the Role: Respond to and resolve issues that affect acquisition, production, and content distribution across multiple DEE networks including system outages, malfunctions, and related technical problems, and conduct diagnostic testing, repair, and replacement activities necessary to solve routine, specialized, and complex problems. Utilize system health and performance monitoring software and platforms; troubleshoot and participate in repairing system problems and failures, participates in maintenance of systems, installs software patches, updates etc., to resolve and avoid service problems, and troubleshoots system problems as they relate to these services. Analyze and troubleshoot streaming audio/video signals in traditional SDI and IP 2110 essence flow routing environments. Analyze and troubleshoot cloud platforms as necessary Support third-party service providers by enforcing the agreed upon scope of services within the various signed service agreements (i.e., full time, freelance, union agencies, maintenance providers, contractors, service providers, etc.). Select, train, motivate and evaluate technical staff; provide or coordinate staff training; work with employees to correct deficiencies; implement discipline procedures. Support the procurement of equipment, supplies and materials for Media technology systems within budget guidelines; receive and maintain equipment and supplies. Support long range planning for future media technology needs, including capital improvements, to enhance production and distribution capabilities. Lead the development and implementation of policies and procedures regarding technology facilities with a focus on maximizing the integration of all systems to meet business, marketing, and entertainment goals. Lead operational support of all activities related to operating, maintaining, and programming the audio and video production/distribution systems across the enterprise and other connected properties. When required perform preventative maintenance on all broadcast systems and equipment, such as distribution systems, switchers, consoles, playout servers, cameras, robotics, electromechanical equipment, automation systems and radio facilities to ensure optimum broadcast performance. Participates in engineering projects at the direction of more experienced engineers. Reviews and contributes to system/workflow documentation. Participates in regular training and development objectives. Extraordinary influencer who is skilled at connecting the dots at the organization, strategy, program, project, and event levels. Able to persuade and change the thinking of others without damaging relationships. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growth environment with minimal direction, delivering under tight deadlines while multitasking, prioritizing projects, and communicating priority updates to team members. Able to operate with limited resources, exhibit objective critical-thinking, and creatively solve problems. Motivated and inventive, always finds a way forward—eternal optimist with a committed drive for contributing and making a difference. Any other duties needed to help achieve Business Objectives. Required Education, Experience/Skills/Training: Minimum Qualifications: 7 + years of previous and relevant experience in leading others, developing technical strategies ensuring efficient sustainment, uptime, and overall stability of the technical environments of Media Engineering and live media production and distribution environments. Expert level knowledge and experience with integrating, implementing, or refreshing broadcast control room equipment, including familiarity with modern broadcast cabling infrastructure used in broadcast environments. Proficient with technologies like microservices, DevOps tools, design principles, practices, standards and guidelines Scripting proficiency will be an advantage (Python, NodeJS, Bash, PowerShell) Proficient in SMPTE standards for broadcast television and video production/streaming environments with a current certification such as not limited to ST 292M, ST 424M, ST 2110, ST 2059, IEE1588, ST 2022-7, SCTE-104, etc. Advanced level knowledge and experience with on-prem and cloud-based storage and compute infrastructure platforms and current technological offerings. At least one foundational cloud certification required, including but not limited to Microsoft Certified: Microsoft Azure Fundamentals, CompTIA Cloud+, AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate. Advanced level knowledge and experience with compression techniques such as MPEG2/4, HEVC, JPEG 2000, and JPEG XS Expert level knowledge and experience with Evertz software control systems such as frame control via VistaLink or Magnum, EQX/EXE routers, and their monitoring software VLPRO, SDVN, VIP, VUE, MVP. Advanced level knowledge and experience with major media systems and the vendors that supply them in areas such as asset management systems, file-based workflows, media acquisition, transcoding/encoding, graphics, and NAS/SAN technologies. Expert level knowledge and experience with Nielsen (NACAT), VANC equipment, Linear Acoustics, and other related systems. Expert level knowledge and experience with coordinated receiver decoders IRDs, core devices, edge devices, timing of video and audio systems, audio and video media file formats are a plus. Ability to create, read and interpret AutoCAD and other technical drawing/documentation tools. Demonstrated expert troubleshooting and sustaining in one or more of the following: IP-based broadcast equipment including routers, switchers, audio boards, signal processers, encoder/decoder, video scalers, playback systems, etc. Studio technology includes video walls, cameras, VR set technology, image processing systems, touch screens, lighting, etc. File-based workflows like enterprise Media Asset Management systems (Cloud-based Cloud Compute or Local Network-based) including storage, compute, encode and distribution. Production control systems such as Imagine Communications or Grass Valley automation systems, Avid, Adobe, Viz, Dalet, Riedel trunking, Lawo, Calrec, Evertz, Ross and others. Transmission systems such as RF (Radio Frequency), Satellite Distribution, Fiber Distribution, etc. Proven track record for troubleshooting and sustainment knowledge of AWS Infrastructures and other cloud-based technologies including S3/Glacier storage and cloud compute (EC2) services. Physical requirements and work environment: Ability to climb ladders, work on raised structures and building roofs, operate areal lift platforms and have valid driver’s license. Required Education: Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent work experience #DisneyTECH The hiring range for this position in The Woodlands,TX is $125,000.00 - $167,600.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This is a B2B2C role: our patients interact with Wheel through partner brands, so you'll need to design experiences that satisfy a consumer's expectations for a modern healthcare product while also meeting the technical, brand, and compliance requirements of large enterprise partners. You'll operate at a systems level, connecting patient-facing experience decisions to the underlying clinical, operational, and platform architecture that makes those experiences possible. You bring real hands-on experience shaping AI-powered product, not just using AI tools in your own workflow. This is a builder role for a senior product leader who can set a multi-year vision for patient experience and drive it forward through close, hands-on partnership with Engineering. WHAT YOU'LL DO (JOB DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES) Strategy & Vision - Define the multi-year vision and roadmap for the patient experience across Wheel's white-labeled consumer surfaces, balancing partner-specific requirements with a coherent, scalable core product - Establish a point of view on where the patient experience should be standardized across partners versus configured per partner, and build the frameworks to support that decision-making - Translate enterprise partner requirements across market segments into a unified product strategy that serves patients well regardless of the front door they came through - Champion design as a strategic differentiator; work hand-in-hand with Design to set a bar for what a trustworthy, AI+human powered patient experience looks like at scale Systems Thinking & Cross-Functional Execution - Map the patient journey end to end, from first touchpoint through clinical encounter to follow-up, and identify where friction, drop-off, or trust gaps occur - Partner closely with Engineering, Clinical Operations, and partner-facing teams to design solutions that hold up across a distributed network of clinicians and multiple partner integrations - Define the product requirements, success metrics, and evaluation criteria for AI-driven capabilities within the patient experience (for example, intake, triage support, or personalization), including partnering on model and product tradeoffs and on iteration post-launch based on real usage data - Break down ambiguous, cross-functional problems into clear requirements and plans, and drive alignment with Engineering from concept through launch and iteration Cross-Functional Leadership - Act as a primary product voice in conversations with Account Management and their enterprise partners about patient experience, translating patient experience strategy into terms that resonate with partner stakeholders - Communicate vision, tradeoffs, and progress clearly to executive leadership, engineering teams, and non-technical partner stakeholders alike - Mentor and influence other product managers on systems thinking and product craft in partnership with their managers WHO YOU ARE (JOB QUALIFICATIONS) - 8+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning consumer-facing products at a senior or lead level (Staff, Principal or equivalent scope). Leveling will be based on demonstrated scope of impact in the interview process - Direct experience building consumer products, ideally including B2B2C or white-label models where the end user and the paying customer are different - Demonstrated systems thinking: experience designing products that span multiple stakeholders, technical layers, or partner integrations - Real, hands-on experience delivering AI-powered products and features, not just using AI tools in your work. You can speak to the tradeoffs, evaluation methods, and iteration cycles involved in bringing an AI capability to production - Experience navigating the tension between enterprise partner requirements and end-user needs in a B2B2C model, particularly within healthcare or other highly regulated industries, and building product decision frameworks that satisfy compliance, brand, and clinical constraints while still serving the end consumer well - Outstanding written and verbal communicator who can move fluidly between consumer experience detail and executive-level strategy - A track record as a builder: comfortable in ambiguity, willing to get hands-on with design, data, or requirements detail when needed to keep Engineering moving fast Skills & Competencies - Mix of vision and execution: able to set a compelling multi-year direction and also drive the week-to-week product decisions that translate into shipped work - Strong product sense for consumer experience, balanced with the operational and technical judgment needed for a B2B2C model - Experience partnering with enterprise or channel partners on product decisions - Technical fluency across APIs, integration patterns (webhooks, headless architectures, MCP and other emerging protocols), and platform product design - Comfortable synthesizing input from clinical, engineering, data, and partner stakeholders into a clear product direction - Data-driven, with the judgment to know when qualitative signal matters more than a metric - High ownership and autonomy; thrives in a fast-moving, lean environment SALARY AND PERKS Pay Range: $201,700-$301,700 plus equity Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, the final level determined (Staff or Principal), scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations. Wheel is unable to consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. As an employee of Wheel, you’ll enjoy our Total Rewards Program to help secure your financial future and preserve your health and well-being, including: - Medical, Dental and Vision - Ancillary: Life, Short and Long Term Disability - 401K match - Flexible PTO - Parental Leave - Stock options - Additional programs and perks Wheel is committed to equal employment opportunities for all team members. Every decision we make regarding employment is solely based on merit, competence, and performance. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. Research shows that underrepresented groups typically apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria listed. At Wheel, we encourage women, people of color, and LGBTQ+ job seekers to apply for positions even if they don’t check every box for the role.

title: Senior IT Project Manager
jd_text: At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award-winning learning programs like i-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world-class programs and support every day. As a key member of CA's Major Projects Office, you'll be responsible for planning and executing complex technical projects and delivering business value while managing project constraints of scope, schedule, resources/budget and quality. You'll plan and designate project resources, prepare budgets, monitor progress, identify and mitigate risks, and keep stakeholders informed throughout the project. The Major Projects Office leads enterprise-scale programs that transform the way we do our work. Reporting into the Director, IT Project Management, you'll have an opportunity to bring your experience and expertise to bear to help shape the growth of this function, ensuring we're ready to lead CA's most complex, innovative, and impactful projects. The Impact You'll Have: Plan, schedule, and execute complex projects to provide business value through software implementations. Communicate effectively with stakeholders and team members to understand project requirements, expectations, and constraints. Allocate resources efficiently to meet project objectives and deliverables. Manage the vendor contracting process to a fully executed contract. Monitor vendor resources, vendor delivery, and successful execution of vendor contracts. Identify, assess, mitigate, and escalate project risks to positively impact project success. Provide leadership and direction to project teams, fostering a fun, collaborative, and high-performance work environment. Prepare regular progress reports and project documentation, highlighting key milestones, risks, and achievements. Be the voice of the project to senior and executive leadership. Drive continuous improvements within the project management process, identifying opportunities for efficiency gains and best practices, particularly through AI. Mentor and support junior project managers. What We're Looking For: 8+ years of experience with a track record of successfully leading complex projects to completion. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate and inspire project teams to achieve their best performance. Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, fostering a culture of collaboration and knowledge sharing. Effective problem-solving and decision-making abilities, with a proactive and solution-oriented approach to project challenges. Flexibility and adaptability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment, managing multiple priorities and deadlines effectively. Meticulous attention to detail, ensuring accuracy and precision in project planning, execution, and documentation. Knowledge of Agile frameworks and hybrid project management approaches. PMP or other project management certification preferred. Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Management Information Systems, or equivalent preferred. Experience creating or leveraging AI-enabled project management practices preferred. Benefits and Pay Range: Pay Range – This role’s range is $93,250 - $166,250 The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that Curriculum Associates considers in making compensation decisions based on our Compensation Philosophy. Actual base pay within that range will vary based upon several factors including, but not limited to, prior experience and relevant skill sets. At Curriculum Associates, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances for each case. This role is also eligible to participate in the company bonus plan. The Company recognizes that minimum wage varies by location and will ensure all compensation decisions comply with applicable state and local laws. Benefits – Benefit eligible employees (and their families) are covered by medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Employees can enroll in our company’s 401k plan and receive an employer match. Employees have access to a flexible vacation and sick policy in addition to twelve paid holidays and a winter office closure between Christmas and New Year's, as well as a number of additional perks and benefits. Application deadline: September 7, 2026. This is subject to close earlier if there is a high volume of applicants or a qualified hire is made.

title: Architect (Azure/Purview) - Data Governance Platforms
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>Are you looking for a role that motivates and challenges you? Are you ready for an opportunity for growth? Do you want to work on teams where people roll up their sleeves to take on tough problems together, and regularly blow the doors off our clients with their outstanding teamwork? If you answered yes to those questions, 3Cloud might just be for you!</p> <p>At 3Cloud, we hire people who aren’t afraid to experiment or fail. We hire people who are willing to give direct and candid feedback to their managers, leaders, and team members. We hire people who jump at those opportunities because they care about our collective growth and success. We hire people who challenge and hold each other accountable for living 3Cloud’s core values because they know that it will result in amazing experiences and solutions for our clients and each other.</p></div><p>The Architect in Delivery is a hands-on technical lead for cloud solutions. You design and deliver secure, scalable, and maintainable systems on Azure that solve real business problems. You own end-to-end architecture for your projects, stay close to implementation where it matters, and work with teams to meet goals for value, security, performance, reliability, and cost. At this level, you lead solution design in your primary domain, guide engineers day to day, and mentor other architects and technical leads. You turn business needs into clear technical plans, help teams make good tradeoffs, and keep delivery predictable and high quality.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong></p> <p><strong>&nbsp;Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li>&nbsp;Deep experience in implementing one of the following: <ul> <li>Profisee (MDM) to include SaaS and PaaS configurations, matching and survivorship, hierarchies, workflows, user interfaces, and data integrations (inbound and outbound).</li> <li>&nbsp;Microsoft Purview to include data map and scanning, Unified Catalog, glossary development, data quality, data lineage, classification, and access/ownership models.</li> <li>Databricks Unity Catalog to include metastores design and rollout, workspaces across Dev, Test, and Prod, migration from Hive Metastore, classification and tagging and lineage.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Familiarity with common enterprise data governance roles, operations, and processes.</li> <li>Good business acumen and communication skills for requirements gathering at broad organizational levels.</li> <li>Own end-to-end architecture and scope for your projects, leading teams to design and deliver Azure solutions that meet agreed goals for value, security, scalability, reliability, performance, and cost.</li> <li>Serve as the technical lead and subject matter expert on your engagements, guiding consultants and engineers so implementation stays aligned with the architecture and standards.</li> <li>Apply sound engineering practices—clear interfaces, modular design, and testability—to produce reliable, maintainable solutions in your primary domain. Provide architectural guidance throughout implementation, including design and pull-request reviews, shaping cloud patterns and guardrails and offering practical options to unblock teams.</li> <li>Use AI tools to accelerate code, tests, documentation, and similar tasks, and share effective practices so they become repeatable gains for teams and clients.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Delivery and Consulting Excellence</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead discovery and requirements sessions for your workstreams, clarifying scope, dependencies, and risks, and shaping a prioritized backlog with clear acceptance criteria tied to business outcomes.</li> <li>Explain complex technical topics in simple, direct language for both technical and non-technical audiences, and consistently connect technical decisions back to client goals.</li> <li>Build trust with managers and product owners, influencing priorities and roadmaps in ways that support the client’s long-term interests.</li> <li>&nbsp;Enable teams to deliver with stable velocity and low defect rates by providing clear architecture, interfaces, and automation across build, test, and deployment, and by designing for incremental delivery with a clear Definition of Done.</li> <li>&nbsp;Align multiple teams on shared outcomes, contracts, and integration points, ensuring dependencies are identified early, owned, and tracked through delivery.</li> <li>Support effective Agile practices by ensuring the architecture and backlog structure enable incremental delivery, a clear Definition of Done, and data-informed course corrections based on telemetry and feedback. Mentorship and Team Development</li> </ul> <p><strong>Mentorship and Team Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Mentor others through pairing, design reviews, and clear feedback that strengthens design skills, technical judgment, and confidence, with a particular focus on senior engineers and technical leads.</li> <li>Provide architectural oversight across teams or workstreams, modeling pragmatic decision-making and teaching others when to keep designs simple and when to introduce new patterns or technologies.</li> <li>Support hiring and growth by participating in technical interviews, calibration discussions, and crossproject mentorship.</li> <li>&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Growth and Innovation</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities across all our capabilities (beyond own specialty) and communicating them to the sales director.</li> <li>Partner with sales and account leaders on pursuits by defining the cloud vision, contributing architectural viewpoints, and participating in client workshops, demos, and roadmap discussions.</li> <li>Produce solution options, high-level designs, and estimates in your domains, clearly documenting assumptions, dependencies, and risks and explaining how proposed approaches drive business value and reduce risk.</li> <li>Create and maintain reusable assets—such as runbooks, workshops, starter repositories, and templates—that make it easier for engineers to deliver consistent solutions.</li> <li>Champion modern frameworks, patterns, tools, and AI-assisted practices that improve quality, speed, or reliability in a secure and responsible way.</li> <li>Actively participate in enablement efforts that support a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong> Requirements </strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of experience in data governance, data management, in a cloud environment&nbsp;</li> <li>Proven experience leading hybrid and remote teams and maintaining alignment, quality, and predictable delivery across time zones.</li> <li>Expertise in at least one major public cloud platform, with Azure strongly preferred.</li> <li>Deep understanding of core concepts, languages, frameworks, and design patterns in your primary domain, with the ability to apply them to build robust, maintainable systems.</li> <li>Experience using AI-augmented development and integrating AI or machine learning capabilities into solutions through APIs, libraries, or cloud-based AI services.</li> <li>2+ years with Azure technologies.</li> <li>Proven experience delivering governance programs.</li> <li>Strong understanding of data platform and analytics ecosystems.</li> <li>Experience with 2 or more Data Management areas:&nbsp; Data Warehousing and Business Intelligence, Data Science and ML, Master Data Management, Data Governance, and Data Quality Management.</li> <li>Experience working in Agile or Scrum environments, including backlog refinement and iteration planning.</li> <li>Experience in consulting or professional services is a plus.</li> <li>Familiarity with key cloud services for your domain, such as messaging, compute, data, security, networking, and integration.</li> <li>Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with clear written and verbal communication.</li> <li>Demonstrated </ul> <p>Don’t meet every single requirement?
