title: Experience Technical Architect, Innovation & Emerging Technologies
jd_text: Job Description: The Experience Technical Architect, Innovation & Emerging Technologies is a hands-on, full-stack technical architect who owns the technical architecture and implementation of AI and agentic prototype solutions within Horizon's committed-build phase, bringing deep experience building rapid proofs-of-concept and shipping at speed under compressed timelines. This role translates solution architectures into working, tested code spanning custom integrations and programming languages/frameworks, data pipelines, and agentic automation, with a track record of threading custom development into platforms across the Adobe ecosystem (i.e., AEM, GenStudio, Firefly, CX Enterprise CoWorker, Adobe Experience Platform, and adjacent Adobe products). Balancing velocity with code quality in an agile, iterative delivery model, the Experience Technical Architect establishes and applies coding standards, drives prototypes to production readiness under compressed timelines, and maintains the patterns and documentation that make knowledge transfer possible. Key Responsibilities The responsibilities below reflect core needs for this role. Lead sprint execution, breaking solution architecture into testable, shippable increments across two-week sprints. Build custom integrations, data pipelines, custom interfaces, and agentic automation, including fine-tuned AI models, wiring GenStudio, Firefly, CX Enterprise CoWorker, AEP, and AEM into customer systems via APIs. Design and implement custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) connectors that enable seamless integration between Adobe’s AI/agentic solutions and client enterprise systems, accelerating prototype time-to-value and reducing manual data handoffs. Architect third-party connector strategies and build integration patterns that extend Adobe capabilities into client data ecosystems, knowledge bases, and operational systems while maintaining data governance and security standards. Lead AI hardening and production readiness validation for emerging capabilities and custom builds, identifying edge cases, failure modes, and mitigation strategies before client pilot launch. Define data schemas, lineage, and governance frameworks that support experimental AI use cases, ensuring data quality and traceability as prototypes move from innovation labs into production pilots. Write and ship production-quality code hands-on across the stack (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, Node.js, React) and operate within agile build/deploy cadences, including CI/CD pipelines, feature branching, and frequent iterative releases. Establish coding standards, run code reviews, and work closely with other developers to align on technical patterns, quality practices, and integration best practices. Work with solution architects to stress-test technical feasibility and feed implementation learnings back into architecture decisions. Partner with the Lead Architect, Product Manager, and Innovation Strategy Lead to clearly document integration approaches, configuration decisions, and known issues, so future teams can sustain and extend the build. Track technical dependencies and coordinate with customer infrastructure teams to secure timely access to the staging and production environments you need to build, test, and ship. Partner with QA to execute test plans and validate releases before they ship. Required Qualifications 8+ years of software engineering or technical architecture experience, including hands-on development across backend, front-end, and data integration technologies. 3+ years of hands-on experience developing or integrating solutions within the Adobe ecosystem, with experience across one or more Adobe solutions and extending platform capabilities through APIs and custom development. 3+ years of experience designing and building API-based integrations, data pipelines, or event-driven architectures connecting enterprise platforms and customer-experience applications. 2+ years of hands-on experience building AI-enabled applications or solutions, including experience with AI-assisted coding, prompt engineering, agent/LLM configurations, fine-tuning, or custom AI model integration. Hands-on proficiency in at least 3 relevant programming languages/frameworks, such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, Node.js, React, and SQL. 5+ years working in agile software development environments, including Scrum/Kanban, 1-2 week sprints, CI/CD deploy pipelines, feature branching, and frequent iterative releases. Demonstrated experience taking at least 2 rapid proofs-of-concept or prototypes through implementation or production/pilot readiness, ideally within compressed timelines and ambiguous, rapidly changing requirements. Demonstrated experience defining technical patterns and coding standards, conducting code reviews, and working with other developers to maintain code quality. Strong problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to operate effectively in emerging-technology environments with minimal guardrails. Additional Information The annual base salary range for this position is $136,000 - $190,000. Placement within the salary range is based on a variety of factors, including relevant experience, knowledge, skills, and other factors permitted by law. Additionally, this position is eligible for discretionary incentive compensation. Benefits available with this position include: · Medical, vision, and dental insurance · Life insurance · Short-term and long-term disability insurance · 401k · Flexible paid time off · At least 15 paid holidays per year · Paid sick and safe leave · Paid parental leave Dentsu also complies with applicable state and local laws regarding employee leave benefits, including, but not limited to providing time off pursuant to the Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act, in accordance with its plans and policies. For further details regarding Dentsu benefits, please visit www.dentsubenefitsplus.com. To begin the application process, please click on the “Apply” button at the top of this job post. Our way of working combines flexibility with in-person collaboration to spark ideas and strengthen our teams. title: Lead Enterprise Architect
jd_text: Job Description: The Enterprise Architecture Lead is a senior technical leader within Merkle’s Digital Product Engineering (DPE) practice, part of the broader Digital Experience (DX) organization. DPE serves as Merkle’s rapid innovation engine and cross-capability orchestrator, delivering bespoke product development, composable modernization, and AI-powered solutions for Fortune 100 clients. This role combines deep enterprise architecture expertise with a product engineering mindset. The candidate must be equally comfortable governing complex, multi-platform delivery programs and shaping what gets built and why, leading multi-disciplinary engineering teams through the practical development and delivery of production-grade solutions. The Enterprise Architecture Lead operates in close partnership with DPE’s Technology Lead, who owns the agentic AI and emerging technology workstream on the account. Together, they form a complementary architecture leadership pair: one focused on the foundational platform ecosystem, integration architecture, and delivery governance; the other on next-generation AI capabilities and innovation. This collaboration model ensures the client receives both operational stability and forward-looking technical vision from a unified DPE team. Position Requirements & Scope This position is aligned with Merkle’s Digital Product Engineering practice, which focuses on building and delivering complex, scalable digital products and platforms for enterprise clients. The position will be focused on one of our top-tier client accounts, a global communications services provider and technology company that represents a significant growth opportunity within DPE’s portfolio. Specifically, this position will be responsible for owning the enterprise architecture layer across the engagement, ensuring platform integrity and delivery rigor as the client’s strategic roadmap progresses. This is a long-term, strategic leadership role on the account, requiring sophisticated solution positioning, innovative integrations including AI, and capability progression against a strategic roadmap. Critical Role Requirements This is a senior, embedded position on a dedicated client team, filling a specialized enterprise architecture capability within DPE’s delivery model. The Enterprise Architecture Lead is responsible for translating an approved strategic roadmap into shipped, scalable solutions - ensuring architectural coherence, platform interoperability, and execution discipline across every workstream. This role is essential for: Architectural Governance & Delivery Oversight - Owning the end-to-end technical architecture across the engagement, ensuring all solution components align to the approved roadmap, adhere to enterprise standards, and are delivered with the quality and rigor expected of a world-class digital product engineering organization. Multi-Platform Solution Architecture - Designing and governing integrated, enterprise-class solutions anchored in the Adobe ecosystem (AEM, AEP, Target, Analytics, Workfront) while orchestrating adjacent platforms (Salesforce Clouds, middleware, data infrastructure, and enterprise integration layers) into a unified, cohesive architecture. This includes defining clear architectural boundaries and integration contracts with the agentic AI workstream. Web & Digital Experience Delivery - Leading the initial phase of work focused on uplifting the client’s most critical digital properties, using Adobe Experience Manager as the foundational platform while ensuring the architecture is composable enough to support future modernization and AI-powered enhancement. Enterprise Integration Architecture - Designing scalable integration patterns across platforms, APIs, data layers, and middleware to ensure seamless data flow, system interoperability, and operational resilience across a complex, global technology estate. This includes defining the integration surface between traditional platform services and emerging AI/agent capabilities. Delivery Excellence & Execution Discipline - Bringing the operational rigor and delivery methodology of a world-class product engineering engagement: sprint-level architecture involvement, technical debt management, dependency mapping, risk mitigation, and hands-on leadership that keeps large, multi-team programs on track. Technical Leadership & Team Orchestration - Leading and mentoring multi-disciplinary delivery teams (developers, platform specialists, data engineers, QA) across workstreams, ensuring technical alignment, quality standards, and consistent architectural decision-making. Client-Facing Technical Partnership - Serving as a senior technical authority with client stakeholders at the VP and C-suite level, translating complex architectural decisions into business-relevant language and building confidence in the delivery approach. Presenting a coherent technical narrative that connects platform stability with innovation velocity. Innovation Within Execution - Identifying and incorporating emerging capabilities (AI-powered personalization, intelligent automation, agentic workflows) into the delivery roadmap where they add measurable value, not as theoretical exercises, but as production-ready enhancements integrated within the existing architecture. Working with DPE’s Technology Lead to evaluate where AI capabilities should be natively embedded vs. independently orchestrated. Cross-Practice Orchestration - Collaborating with Merkle’s adjacent practices (Content Technology, Commerce, Experience Design, Analytics) to compose solutions where DPE provides the product engineering spine. Ensuring solution designs leverage cross-practice expertise while maintaining DPE’s architectural standards and delivery accountability. Business Impact & ROI This role is the linchpin between strategy and delivered value. Without senior enterprise architecture leadership, complex multi-platform engagements risk fragmentation, scope drift, and technical debt that erode both client outcomes and Merkle margins. The Enterprise Architecture Lead directly protects and grows the engagement by ensuring delivery stays on-roadmap, architecture remains sound under the pressure of real-world execution, and the client sees consistent, tangible progress. This is the role that earns the next phase of work, not through a pitch , but through proof of execution. Critically, this role operates in tandem with DPE’s Technology Lead on the agentic workstream, which represents the largest growth opportunity on the account. By establishing a stable, well-governed platform foundation, the Enterprise Architecture Lead creates the conditions for the agentic workstream to deliver at pace and scale, directly supporting DPE’s revenue growth objectives . This hire reinforces Merkle’s credibility as a premier digital product engineering partner, demonstrating that DPE doesn’t just design solutions but builds and ships them at enterprise scale with the architectural discipline and product thinking that Fortune 100 clients expect. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college/university; M aster’s degree or relevant certifications (Adobe Certified Expert/Master, Salesforce certifications, TOGAF, AWS/GCP) strongly preferred 15+ years of hands-on enterprise architecture and solution delivery experience, with a significant portion spent in large-scale SI or digital product engineering environments (e.g., Accenture, Deloitte Digital, Thoughtworks, or equivalent product-minded organizations) Broad multi-platform fluency: Working delivery experience with adjacent enterprise platforms including Salesforce (Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Service Cloud), middleware/integration platforms (MuleSoft, Informatica, or equivalent), cloud infrastructure (AWS, Azure, GCP), and data platforms (Snowflake or similar). The differentiator is the ability to compose these into a unified architecture rather than operate them in isolation. AI literacy and integration aptitude: While not required to be an AI/ML specialist, must demonstrate a working understanding of how agentic AI, LLM-powered services, and intelligent automation integrate into enterprise architectures. title: Data Architect, Product Modernization
jd_text: Job Description: Ready to help shape what’s next in Adobe? Join Merkle’s Adobe Practice and help enterprise brands modernize the data foundations behind their digital experiences. This is an opportunity to tackle complex transformation challenges, influence future-state architecture, and build scalable solutions across Adobe Experience Platform, Analytics, Content, and Commerce. We are seeking an experienced Data Architect to lead the design and delivery of product modernization initiatives for enterprise customers migrating legacy Adobe solutions to modern platforms across Analytics, Content, and Commerce domains. You will architect and operationalize the end-to-end data foundations that power our customers' digital marketing, content, and commerce ecosystems — spanning data strategy, modeling, integration, and governance across Adobe Experience Platform, content operations, CRM systems, and commerce applications. As an enterprise data architecture, you'll design the schemas, pipelines, and governance frameworks behind secure, scalable solutions that support unified profiles, segmentation, journey orchestration, and campaign activation for our customers. What You'll Do Provide deep experience to build data solutions across multiple Adobe products and cloud platforms aligned with enterprise data strategy. Engage closely with customers and Adobe team to facilitate data discovery by evaluating systems and business processes. Analyze customer sources, data movement, data granularity, relationships, data format, etc. Unify disparate data (e.g., sales, CRM, analytics data, etc.) to meet customers’ digital marketing use cases. Lead and develop conceptual, logical, and physical data models for multi-solution delivery. Showcase and follow frameworks for data quality, define standards, master data management, data services, data governance, data modeling, tools, data security, privacy, and compliance with industry regulations (PII, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR, etc.). Engage with cross-disciplinary groups and Adobe professionals to identify customer demands. Provide data layout and strategic blueprints, advocating for scalable, secure resolutions. Assume the role of a liaison to promptly tackle technical obstacles. Provide solutions for growing data volumes, tools, and integrations, while aligning to customers’ objectives. Deliver Adobe platform data lake and real-time customer profile to get ready for data ingestion and activation. Employ REST APIs, Postman, and basic scripting to automate and streamline the implementation and setup. Develop and construct data ingestion solutions for streaming and batch processing, online and offline data within AEP. Collaborate with data engineers to develop and implement ETL/ELT pipelines for data collection and extraction. Improve data query performance across platforms by tuning models and adhering to guidelines and ensure product guardrails are followed and deployed in solutions Drives end-to-end data migration initiatives, transforming and migrating large-scale datasets while maintaining data quality, integrity, and compliance. Audit existing Adobe solutions to establish current state baseline and identify technical debt, governance gaps, and data quality issues. Assess platform maturity: evaluate taxonomy consistency, content metadata tagging practices and standards compliance, and commerce product data enrichment levels; flag redesign opportunities prior to modernization. Identify platform-specific reconciliation and integration points and document data consistency requirements. Unify disparate data sources (CRM, call center, marketing, sales, content operations, commerce/order data) to meet customers' digital marketing, content, and commerce use cases within a single AEP foundation. Map legacy platform infrastructure to AEP schemas and CJA data views; determine what migrates directly, what requires transformation, and what should be redesigned for improved governance and cross-domain insights. Design AEP data models (conceptual, logical, physical) across Analytics, Content, and Commerce domains—including event schemas, entity relationships, attribute hierarchies, identity resolution, content asset structures, and product data models. Develop relational and dimensional data models for analytics spanning multiple customer datasets (CRM, marketing, offline, point-of-sale, content, commerce) across RDBMS, columnar, data warehouse, and data lake environments. Architect AEP data ingestion pipelines (streaming, batch, online, offline) across Analytics, Content, and Commerce data sources; collaborate with data engineers to build automated ETL/ELT workflows maintaining data freshness and quality. Support end-to-end modernization migrations, preserving metric definitions, historical accuracy, content governance, and commerce data integrity through transition phases. Develop validation and reconciliation documentation for legacy-vs-modern platform comparisons in pilot and production Core Requirements 8+ years of hands-on data architecture, data modeling, SQL development, and analytics platform experience working with enterprise customers. Expert proficiency in crafting customer-centric database models, datasets (e.g., CRM, Call Center, Marketing, Offline, Point of Sale, etc.) with relational, hierarchical (e.g., RDBMS, Columnar, Data Warehouse, BI, Document, Semantic layer modeling, Data Lakes, OLTP & OLAP, etc.). Demonstrated experience auditing, assessing, and documenting data components of implementations; ability to translate complex data configurations and data models into clear business requirements and technical documentation. Advanced SQL skills including window functions, complex joins, aggregations, stored procedures, and query optimization for analytics workloads. Hands-on experience with Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), including data ingestion, schema design, unified profiles, segmentation, real-time activation workflows, and native AI tools. Proficiency in API-first integration patterns (REST, webhooks, Postman) and basic scripting (Python or Bash) for data pipeline automation and validation. Excellent written and verbal communication and strong organizational skills; proven ability to balance concurrent customer engagements and distill complex architectures and migration strategies for executive and technical audiences. title: Analyst/Associate, Investment Engineering (Data Solutions)
jd_text: Job Description: Dimensional's Investment Engineering department is responsible for ownership of investment data, which means managing data from acquisition through distribution, driving analysis to create information from data, and creating the information and analysis consumed by internal and external reports. Collaborate with internal clients to gather and define requirements for core business systems, and then design, build, and test data pipelines in partnership with data engineer resources. Drive efficiency through automation, process design, and implementation. Mentor and provide guidance to junior analysts, fostering skill development and knowledge-sharing across the team. Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field. Master’s degree and/or professional certifications (e.g. CFA) preferred. 3-5+ years of experience working with large investment datasets, performing quantitative analysis, and leveraging SQL, Python, or similar data management tools. Strongly preferred: experience working with financial data sets and vendor platforms (Bloomberg, Factset, Refinitiv, Morningstar, etc.). Demonstrated interest and passion for financial markets. Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams, writing business requirements, and communicating effectively with software engineers. Self-starter with proven ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines. Strong analytical and quantitative problem-solving skills. title: Senior Sales Operations & Compensation Manager
jd_text: ABOUT US Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting. Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less. THE OPPORTUNITY — (REMOTE - USA / CANADA) We are looking for a Senior Sales Operations & Compensation Manager to serve as the embedded operational partner to our Sales organization. Reporting to the Head of Revenue Operations, you'll own the Salesforce data layer, forecasting cadences, compensation administration, and deal desk processes that power Wrapbook's go-to-market engine across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments. This is a high-autonomy role where your work directly impacts revenue predictability — you'll be the person Sales leadership leans on to turn data into accountability, process into pipeline, and comp plans into performance. WHAT YOU'LL DO Salesforce Data Ownership & Hygiene - Own the Salesforce data layer for Sales: object model accuracy, field definitions, pipeline data integrity, and the hygiene processes that keep opportunity data trustworthy. - Build and maintain SFDC reports for Sales — pipeline views, stage conversion, rep activity, attainment — serving as the primary Salesforce reporting resource for Sales leadership and frontline managers. - Define and enforce data entry standards across the Sales org; build the accountability loops (process, tooling, or workflow) that sustain hygiene over time without manual correction. - Partner with the GTM Systems Architect on SFDC configuration changes, flow updates, and object model evolution driven by Sales process needs. - Serve as the Sales-side data partner to the GTM Insights & Analytics Manager, ensuring Salesforce objects and fields are correctly structured as upstream inputs to Snowflake and the BI layer. Forecasting & Pipeline Cadences - Own the Sales forecast process operationally: run the weekly pipeline and forecast review cadence, partner with frontline managers to validate SFDC data (deals, close dates, eGPV, stage accuracy), and ensure action items are followed through. - Prepare pipeline review materials — pulling from SFDC reports — that surface trends, risks, slippage, and coverage gaps by segment for Sales leadership discussion. - Proactively flag forecast risks and data quality issues; escalate coverage shortfalls and drive cross-functional conversations when pipeline generation is off track. - Partner with the GTM Insights & Analytics Manager on forecast accuracy improvement: they bring the BI modeling and historical analysis; you bring the SFDC data discipline and process accountability. - Support GTM MBR and QBR cadences with consistent, SFDC-sourced reporting inputs and segment-level operational narrative. Sales Compensation Design & Administration - Own end-to-end compensation administration for the Sales organization — plan documents, quota assignments, attainment tracking, payout calculations, approval processes and dispute resolution. - Partner with the Head of Revenue Operations and Finance to support annual comp plan design, ensuring plans are aligned to GTM strategy, bookings goals, and crediting rules for both standard and non-standard deal structures. - Maintain the compensation administration platform as the system of record, ensuring calculation accuracy, auditability, and clean data lineage from deal close to payout. - Manage the full comp calendar — plan communication, quota letter distribution, mid-year adjustments, and commission statement delivery. - Administer SPIFs and accelerators; track performance and report outcomes to Sales leadership and Finance. - Build and maintain comp infrastructure that scales with headcount growth and plan complexity — modular, documented, and auditable. Sales Process & Deal Desk Operations - Own the documentation and operationalization of Sales processes and methodology — ensuring consistent execution from prospecting through close. - Partner with Sales leadership and Enablement to drive process adoption and accountability, with clear feedback loops on where breakdowns occur in the funnel. - Own the deal desk process for standard and non-standard pricing: define the approval matrix, set and enforce SLAs, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure contract and implementation handoffs execute without friction. - Identify process gaps and prioritize improvements in partnership with the GTM Systems Architect; translate Sales business requirements into system changes. - Optimize the Marketing → Sales → Implementation → Customer Success handoff, reducing friction at each transition point. Operating Cadences & GTM Rhythm - Own the weekly pipeline and forecast review end-to-end: preparation, facilitation, and follow-through. - Track open headcount and hiring progress across the Sales org; flag capacity and coverage risks to RevOps and Sales leadership. - Partner with Sales leadership on bookings planning — coordinating inputs from segment leads, validating against historical data, and stress-testing plan assumptions. - Support segment performance reviews by preparing SFDC-sourced operational inputs; partner with GTM Insights for the analytical narrative layer. WHAT YOU'LL HAVE We're looking for a Salesforce-native Sales operator who combines system precision with process ownership — someone whose SFDC data is clean enough to trust, whose comp statements arrive on time and without errors, and whose forecast reviews actually improve rep behavior. Core Experience & Mindset - 5–8 years in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Business Operations in a B2B SaaS environment. - Deep Salesforce ownership experience — object model design, data hygiene management, and SFDC as the system of record for Sales. - Direct experience owning sales compensation administration — plan design support, attainment tracking, payout calculation, and dispute management. - Proven ability to own a forecasting cadence: running the process, driving data discipline in CRM, and delivering reliable roll-ups to leadership. - Comfortable building and maintaining SFDC reports and dashboards for Sales leadership and frontline managers. - Working knowledge of how Salesforce data flows into downstream systems — sufficient to partner effectively with Analytics Engineering and GTM Insights without owning those layers. Familiarity with modern data stack tooling (Snowflake, dbt, Fivetran, or equivalent) is a plus. - High ownership orientation — identifies what needs to be done and does it without being directed. - Strong cross-functional communicator: fluent in a forecast review with a sales manager and a comp dispute conversation with Finance in the same week. - Comfortable in a fast-moving, build-mode environment with limited process inheritance. Salesforce & Technical Fluency - Advanced Salesforce experience — object model design, reporting, dashboards, pipeline management, data hygiene, Flows. - Salesforce Administrator Certification (Plat-Admn-201) — strongly preferred. - Familiarity with how SFDC data is modeled in Snowflake/dbt as downstream inputs — sufficient to collaborate with the GTM Insights Manager and Analytics Engineering. - Comfort working across adjacent tools: comp administration tools, spreadsheet modeling, and BI platforms (Omni/Looker) as a consumer or contributor. - Familiarity with compensation administration platforms — or demonstrated ability to manage comp with high accuracy in a structured non-tool environment. WHY JOIN US At Wrapbook, creativity meets technology — and not just in the product. In addition to a competitive salary and all the benefits you can expect from a fast-growing technology company, you'll get access to a team of creative problem solvers and the chance to see your contributions make large impacts. Benefits include: - Unlimited Paid Time Off - Work from anywhere in Canada and USA - Health and Dental benefits - Up to $1500 towards IT set up for your home - Up to 2% matching RRSP / 401K - Learning and Development opportunities - Up to $50 USD / $66.50 CAD towards Internet/Cell phone service OUR PLEDGE TO FOSTERING AN INCLUSIVE AND SAFE WORKPLACE Wrapbook pledges to be a harassment- and discrimination-free space for everyone, regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, nationality, neurotype, personal appearance, political affiliation, professional background, race, religion, or sexual identity or orientation. title: Senior Product Manager II - Agreement Data Platform
jd_text: About Us: Wrapbook is the AI platform for production finance. We’re building a system of action that puts finance teams in control of their whole production, from payroll, to spend, to accounting. Built for feature films, TV, and commercials, Wrapbook is trusted by teams at Netflix, Paramount, Anonymous Content, and more. With backing from Andreessen Horowitz, Bessemer Venture Partners, and Jeffrey Katzenberg's WndrCo, our team of 350+ is using AI to transform how finance teams work and empower them to do more with less. The Opportunity: Senior Product Manager II - Agreement Data Platform (Remote - USA / Canada) Do you love the hardest kind of product problem, where the data model is the product and a good decision compounds across everything downstream of it? Are you a self-starter who thrives on technical depth, systems thinking, and real customer stakes? Then this role is for you. We're looking for an experienced Senior Product Manager to own the Agreement Data Platform at the core of Wrapbook's payroll engine. This team owns the union agreements, signatories, job classifications, wage tables, scale rates, and the agreement rules that set the pay floor, and the relationships between them, that every payroll calculation on Wrapbook depends on. Just as importantly, it owns the operator tooling that lets our contract administrators and client operations partners define, configure, and govern that data without engineering in the critical path. This is one of the highest-leverage roles in the product org. Agreement data is the spine of the payroll product: every downstream decision, from rate selection on hire, to pay-rule application on a timecard, to the contributions and reports customers receive, is conditioned on its shape. Your mandate is to make this data accurate, configurable, governable, and legible, and to do it in a way that scales as the number of agreements, signatories, and productions grows. You'll partner with a tenured engineering team and be a key product voice at the crossroads of nearly every payroll team at Wrapbook. What You'll Do: - Own the roadmap and vision for the Agreement Data Platform, aligning customer and operator needs with company priorities. - Treat the data model as the product. Define new entities, attributes, and relationships as the industry negotiates new terms and new agreement types come under scope, and decide what is universal versus agreement-specific. - Drive the operator-led bet. Invest in admin tooling, validation, and self-service primitives so a Contract Administrator can stand up and maintain an agreement end-to-end without an engineering ticket. - Steward legible interfaces. The platform's data is a dependency for every payroll team, so you'll define explicit contracts (APIs, data services) and surface model changes early so other teams can build on your work without surprises. - Partner closely with engineering on high-stakes work: the migration off the legacy job-classification model, the Lookup Service extraction, and rule explainability, where correctness has real financial and legal consequences. - Collaborate cross-functionally with the teams upstream and downstream of you, worker hiring and onboarding, project setup, payroll calculations, contributions, timecards, reporting, client operations, and labor relations, to keep boundaries clear and dependencies predictable. - Define success metrics and use data-driven insight to prioritize and measure impact. - Advocate for accuracy, compliance, and traceability. When a paymaster asks "why did this calculate this way?", the answer should be in the tool, not a Slack thread. - Drive execution end-to-end, from discovery through launch, with predictable delivery. - Use AI tools daily to accelerate your workflow, from discovery and analysis to writing, code comprehension, and prototyping. We expect our PMs to be builders, not just strategists. What You'll Have: - 5+ years of product management experience in a SaaS, fintech, or similarly complex technical environment, with meaningful time owning platform, infrastructure, or data-platform products. - A strong technical orientation. You reason with engineering about data models, service boundaries, integrations, and data flows without heavy hand-holding. We are indexing on more technical than business-oriented profiles for this role. - Proven ability to define and execute product strategy with measurable outcomes, and to independently take an idea from concept to launch. - You are an active, daily user of AI tools to do your job. You use LLMs, AI-assisted coding tools, and AI workflows as core parts of how you ship, and can articulate specifically how AI has changed your PM work. - Experience owning products with high cross-team surface area, where other teams depend on the systems or data you own. - Excellent written communication. Clear, structured, decision-oriented specs and data contracts that engineering can build from without ambiguity. - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to become a subject-matter expert in a complex domain quickly. - Ability to independently leverage data using tools like SQL, Pendo, Omni, or Snowflake to uncover insights and inform decisions. - Bias toward action, balanced with the attention to compliance and quality that a payroll platform demands. Extra Points if You Have: - Domain Expertise: payroll, fintech, or entertainment industry experience, especially with complex compliance or regulatory requirements. - Platform / Data-Layer Experience: you've owned a data model, rules engine, configuration platform, or internal-tooling-for-operators product that other teams built on top of. - Operator Tooling Experience: you've built admin panels or self-serve configuration surfaces that moved work out of engineering and into the hands of operations teams. - Modularization / Service Boundaries: you've helped extract a service or draw an enforced interface boundary inside a large codebase. - AI Builder, Not Just User: beyond using AI tools, you've built prototypes, internal tools, or workflows using LLMs, MCPs, or AI-assisted development tools. You tinker, experiment, and ship. Why Join Us At Wrapbook, creativity meets technology — and not just in the product. In addition to a competitive salary and all the benefits you can expect from a fast-growing technology company, you’ll get access to a team of creative problem solvers and the chance to see your contributions make large impacts. title: Pharmacy Lead technician
jd_text: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. Position Summary: At CVS Health, we are focused on transforming health care for our customers and making our company a great place to work. We help people navigate the health care system – and their personal health care – by improving access, lowering costs and being a trusted partner for every meaningful moment of health. Within our Retail locations, we bring this promise to life with heart every day. Our Pharmacy Lead Technicians (Lead Technicians) play a critical role in supporting our pharmacy teams to consistently deliver on our brand promise. As a Lead Technician, you will be an example for and support the pharmacy team in delivering operational and service excellence within your store. Lead Technicians use and build upon the skills and responsibilities of the Pharmacy Technician/Inventory Specialist, acting as a role model, mentor, and guide to the pharmacy team while supporting the Pharmacy Manager and all Pharmacist(s). As an individual contributor and participant-leader, Lead Technicians assist in ensuring that pharmacy operations run smoothly; patients’ prescriptions are filled promptly, safely, and accurately; and that the team provides caring service that exceeds patient expectations. Lead Technicians champion and coach consistent application of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), best practices, and effective communication with the pharmacy team. Throughout their shifts and in all customer and colleague interactions, they demonstrate genuine care and contribute to a safe and inclusive culture where all people feel valued and empowered. The Lead Technician is responsible for adhering to and championing safe and effective operations of the pharmacy, including but not limited to: Living our purpose by following all company SOPs at each workstation to help our Pharmacists and pharmacy team manage and improve patient health Following, and coaching the pharmacy team to follow, pharmacy workflow and procedures at each pharmacy workstation (i.e., production, pick-up, drive-thru, and drop-off) for safe and accurate prescription fulfillment Contributing to positive patient experiences by showing empathy and genuine care: creating heartfelt and personalized moments while serving patients at pick-up, drive-thru, and over the phone; keeping patients healthy by offering immunizations and other services at the register and over the phone; and demonstrating compassionate care by solving or escalating patient problems Assisting the Pharmacist-on-duty with managing day-to-day activities and delegated administrative tasks, which may include pharmacy scheduling and review of the Digital Workstation Assignment Board, daily/weekly communications, and daily/weekly reporting Maintaining the highest level of self-awareness and providing in-the-moment coaching, training, and mentoring to pharmacy team members while sharing best practices; providing pharmacy team performance feedback to the Pharmacy Manager, as needed, to contribute to their growth and development Overseeing and/or completing inventory activities, as permitted by law, and as directed by the pharmacy leadership team, such as accurately putting away medication deliveries, helping to prepare for and participating in annual physical inventories, and completing cycle counts, returns-to-stocks, waiting bin inventories, etc., acting as back-up and providing mentoring and coaching to the Inventory Specialist where applicable Contributing to a high-performing team, embracing a growth mindset, and being receptive to feedback; actively seeking opportunities to expand leadership competencies, alongside clinical and technical knowledge, to better assist patients Serving as a trusted source of truth to the pharmacy team, using judgement to escalate issues and referring colleagues to the appropriate support channel, as needed (e.g., Pharmacy Manager, Asset Protection, Colleague Relations, Ethics Line, etc.) Remaining flexible for both scheduling and business needs, while contributing to a safe, inclusive, and engaging team dynamic; voluntarily traveling to stores in the market to work shifts as needed by the business Understanding and complying with all relevant federal, state, and local laws, regulations, professional standards, and ethical principles. title: IT Infrastructure Manager
jd_text: CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 9,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture. A culture where you can grow! We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program. Position Overview: The IT Infrastructure Manager leads a team responsible for the engineering, delivery, modernization, and continuous improvement of CCM’s enterprise infrastructure platforms. This role is accountable for designing, building, and delivering secure, scalable, resilient, and supportable technology solutions across CCM’s hybrid infrastructure environment. This is a BUILD-focused leadership role responsible for infrastructure strategy, engineering standards, project delivery, automation, platform modernization, and operational readiness. The IT Infrastructure Manager partners closely with Enterprise Architecture, Security & Risk, Technology Operations, PMO, and business technology stakeholders to ensure infrastructure solutions are well-designed, well-documented, secure, repeatable, and ready for operational support. This role encompasses cloud infrastructure, on-premises infrastructure, network engineering, identity and access platforms, Microsoft 365 and collaboration foundations, endpoint platform foundations, automation, Infrastructure as Code, and enterprise platform delivery. Job Responsibilities: Develop and execute short- and long-term infrastructure roadmaps that support CCM’s business growth, technology modernization, and operational resilience. Translate enterprise technology objectives into practical infrastructure plans across hybrid cloud, AWS, Azure, networking, identity, endpoint foundations, collaboration platforms, and core enterprise services. Define and maintain infrastructure engineering standards, reference architectures, design patterns, documentation expectations, and operational readiness requirements. Drive scalable, repeatable infrastructure delivery through automation, Infrastructure as Code, standard templates, reusable patterns, and disciplined change management. Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Security & Risk to ensure infrastructure solutions align with enterprise architecture principles, security controls, compliance expectations, and business continuity requirements. Evaluate emerging technologies, vendors, services, tools, and delivery models that improve reliability, scalability, cost efficiency, security, and engineering velocity. Develop business cases, cost-benefit analyses, and recommendations for infrastructure investments, modernization initiatives, and platform improvements. Lead the design, engineering, and implementation of infrastructure solutions across CCM’s hybrid environment, including AWS, Azure, on-premises platforms, networking, identity/IAM, Microsoft 365, collaboration tools, and endpoint platform foundations. Oversee infrastructure project delivery from intake through design, implementation, testing, documentation, transition, and operational handoff. Ensure new infrastructure solutions are secure by design, observable, resilient, cost-conscious, supportable, and aligned with enterprise standards. Drive adoption of modern deployment practices, including Infrastructure as Code, Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipelines, automated configuration, scripting, and repeatable release patterns. Provide leadership for infrastructure modernization efforts, lifecycle management, cloud adoption, platform consolidation, technical debt reduction, and service improvement initiatives. Ensure infrastructure designs include appropriate monitoring, alerting, logging, backup, recovery, capacity, performance, and support requirements before transition to Operations. Partner with Technology Operations to ensure clean handoffs, clear runbooks, escalation paths, knowledge transfer, and operational support models. Manage engineering delivery across core infrastructure domains, including cloud platforms, network services, identity services, directory services, collaboration platforms, and enterprise productivity foundations. Support AWS as a required platform capability and Azure as a preferred platform capability, ensuring cloud environments are built with strong governance, security, resiliency, automation, and cost-management practices. Provide leadership across network engineering capabilities such as LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, firewall coordination, connectivity, segmentation, cloud networking, and performance optimization. Guide identity and access platform initiatives involving Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA, privileged access, conditional access, lifecycle management, and least-privilege access models. Support Microsoft 365 and collaboration platform foundations, including governance, platform configuration, security alignment, service enablement, and enterprise adoption needs. Partner with endpoint, security, and operations teams to ensure endpoint platform foundations are standardized, manageable, secure, and aligned with enterprise requirements. Partner with Security & Risk to embed security requirements into infrastructure designs, implementation plans, and operational readiness criteria. Ensure infrastructure platforms support appropriate controls for identity, access, logging, encryption, vulnerability management, patching, lifecycle management, backup, recovery, and resiliency. Support disaster recovery, business continuity, incident readiness, and infrastructure resilience planning. Participate in major incident reviews, root cause analysis, remediation planning, and continuous improvement activities as an infrastructure engineering leader. Ensure infrastructure documentation, architecture diagrams, standards, implementation records, and support procedures remain current and audit-ready. Establish strong delivery practices that balance speed, quality, security, supportability, and long-term maintainability. Maintain clear communication with IT leadership, project stakeholders, Technology Operations, Security & Risk, Enterprise Architecture, PMO, business partners, and vendors. Provide executive-ready updates on infrastructure initiatives, risks, delivery progress, resource needs, dependencies, and decision points. Define and track key performance indicators related to infrastructure delivery, platform health, project execution, technical debt reduction, automation, and operational readiness. Serve as an escalation point for complex infrastructure engineering issues, major production concerns, and high-priority platform decisions. Ensure infrastructure work is prioritized, planned, delivered, documented, and transitioned effectively. Lead, coach, and develop a team of infrastructure engineers and technical professionals. Set clear goals, priorities, standards, and expectations for team delivery, quality, documentation, collaboration, and accountability. Manage team capacity, resource planning, work assignments, performance feedback, hiring, onboarding, and professional development. Build a culture of ownership, continuous improvement, engineering discipline, service excellence, and cross-functional partnership. Promote knowledge sharing, standardization, mentoring, and repeatable delivery practices across the infrastructure team. Manage vendor relationships, technology evaluations, renewals, support agreements, and infrastructure-related procurement activities. Support infrastructure budget planning, forecasting, cloud cost management, licensing reviews, and cost optimization efforts. Partner with PMO and IT leadership to manage the infrastructure project portfolio, prioritize demand, identify delivery risks, and ensure alignment to enterprise objectives. Evaluate infrastructure investments based on business value, risk reduction, operational impact, scalability, security, and total cost of ownership. Participate in escalation support for major incidents, high-priority infrastructure issues, and critical production events. Occasional work outside standard business hours may be required to support planned maintenance, production changes, incident response, and project implementations. Qualifications and Skills: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. One or more industry-recognized certifications in cloud technologies, infrastructure automation, project management, cybersecurity, networking, endpoint management, or IT service management, preferred. 8+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, platform engineering, cloud infrastructure, network engineering, systems engineering, or related technology roles. 3+ years of experience leading infrastructure, platform, systems, network, or cloud engineering teams. Advanced experience delivering infrastructure solutions in a hybrid enterprise environment. Experience leading infrastructure projects from design through implementation, documentation, transition, and support readiness. Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, Ansible, PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar technologies. Experience with CI/CD, Git-based workflows, release management, configuration management, and repeatable deployment practices. Experience with Microsoft 365, collaboration platforms, endpoint platform foundations, and enterprise productivity services. Experience with ITSM practices, change management, incident/problem management, operational readiness, and production support transition. Advanced experience in vendor management, budgeting, cost analysis, and infrastructure investment planning. Experience working in a regulated or security-conscious environment; financial services or mortgage industry experience, preferred. Advanced technical knowledge of AWS, Azure, hybrid infrastructure, virtualization, Windows and Linux server platforms, enterprise storage, backup/recovery, networking, and identity platforms. Advanced knowledge of Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, MFA, conditional access, privileged access, and identity lifecycle management. Knowledge of LAN/WAN, SD-WAN, DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewalls, routing, switching, load balancing, cloud networking, and network segmentation. Knowledge of AWS is required; Azure experience, preferred. Advanced understanding of infrastructure architecture, cloud architecture, networking, identity and access management, Microsoft enterprise platforms, automation, and operational support models. Advanced understanding of monitoring, logging, alerting, observability, capacity planning, performance management, and service reliability practices. Comfortable operating in a large, complex, and rapidly evolving organization. Skilled in leadership, strategic planning, decision-making, and driving execution to achieve business objectives. Skilled in communication, including communicating complex technical topics effectively to both technical and non-technical audiences. Skilled in partnering across Infrastructure, Operations, Security & Risk, Architecture, PMO, and business teams. Highly organized, delivery-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a dynamic environment. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Skilled in evaluating and balancing competing priorities, including quality, security, cost, delivery timelines, and operational requirements. Skilled in aligning technology services with customer requirements, business objectives, and organizational reliability standards. Skilled in talent development, process improvement, standards enhancement, and building effective technical teams. At Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT), one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life. Our team at Integrated DNA Technologies (IDT), is united by a commitment to collaboration and scientific excellence, building on a strong foundation of innovation, expertise, and reliability. Guided by our vision to help researchers rapidly move from the lab to life-changing advances, we work closely with global partners to accelerate progress and genomics breakthroughs across fields like cancer, infectious disease, rare genetic disorders, and more. At IDT, you’ll be part of a culture rooted in continuous learning and improvement—where your growth fuels our mission to accelerate the pace of genomics and helps shape a healthier, brighter future for all. Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. The Manager of Manufacturing Applications is responsible for ensuring compliant, reliable, and validated enterprise manufacturing platforms that support GxP‑regulated operations across the organization. This position reports to the Director of Software Engineering and is part of the IT Manufacturing Applications team and is fully USA remote. In this role, you will have the opportunity to: Own the end‑to‑end management of GxP‑regulated manufacturing systems, including lifecycle planning, enhancements, upgrades, rationalization, and decommissioning. Ensure manufacturing systems operate in compliance with GxP regulations, internal quality standards, and inspection readiness expectations. Coordinate with the Validation team and govern change management for GxP systems, including validation planning, risk assessments, testing, documentation, change impact analysis, and ensuring changes are properly assessed, approved, tested, and deployed in alignment with validation and quality requirements. Partner closely with Quality, Manufacturing, and IT stakeholders to translate operational needs into compliant system capabilities and improvements. Oversee operational stability and performance of GxP systems, including incident management, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs), and continuous improvement. Manage vendors and service partners supporting GxP systems, ensuring compliance, performance, documentation, and service expectations are met. Maintain inspection-ready documentation, support internal and external audits and regulatory inspections, and coordinate training and user enablement to ensure proper system use and sustained compliance. The essential requirements of the job include: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related discipline. At least 4 years of experience supporting or managing manufacturing IT systems in regulated environments, including experience with technically complex systems involving integrations, automation, or custom implementations, and at least 1 year of supervisory, management, technical lead, or team lead experience. Strong understanding of manufacturing systems (e.g., MES, LIMS, QMS, instruments related, or related manufacturing platforms). Experience operating within IT service management and quality governance processes, with hands on software development experience supporting system integrations, automation, or platform enhancements, using technologies such as C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, modern web frameworks (e.g. React), and API based integrations. It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in: Experience supporting global or multi site manufacturing environments. Exposure to manufacturing digital transformation initiatives. Demonstrated experience managing GxP-regulated systems, including validation support, compliance oversight, and change control in collaboration with Quality and Validation teams, while partnering with Manufacturing and Quality organizations to support compliant operations. IDT , a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefit programs that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programs contribute to life beyond the job. Check out our benefits at Danaher Benefits Info . This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay.#LI-Remote We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.
